CUPTI_CORRELATION_ID_UNKNOWN.doc:
An invalid/unknown correlation ID.

A correlation ID of this value indicates that there is no correlation for the activity record.

CUPTI_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES_UNKNOWN.doc: An invalid/unknown value for decompressed bytes.

CUPTI_SOURCE_LOCATOR_ID_UNKNOWN.doc:
The source-locator ID that indicates an unknown source location.

There is not an actual [CUpti_ActivitySourceLocator](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySourceLocator.html#structcupti__activitysourcelocator) object corresponding to this value.

CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN.doc: An invalid/unknown timestamp for a start, end, queued, submitted, or completed time.

CUpti_ActivityApiFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

API_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always either [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DRIVER`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME`].

API_FIELD_CBID.doc: CUpti_CallbackId cbid; Callback ID of the CUDA driver/runtime API function.

API_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; Start timestamp of the CUDA driver/runtime API call (in nanoseconds).

API_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; End timestamp of the CUDA driver/runtime API call (in nanoseconds).

API_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; ID of the process executing the CUDA driver/runtime API call.

API_FIELD_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t threadId; ID of the thread executing the CUDA driver/runtime API call.

API_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this CUDA driver/runtime API invocation.

This ID matches the correlation ID of the associated kernel, memcpy, or memset activity record that the API call initiated.

API_FIELD_RETURN_VALUE.doc: uint32_t returnValue; Return value of the CUDA driver/runtime API call (CUresult or cudaError_t).

CUpti_ActivityAttribute.doc:
Activity attributes.

These attributes are used to control the behavior of the activity API.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_SIZE.doc:
The device memory size (in bytes) reserved for storing profiling data for concurrent kernels (activity kind [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ggaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3a55d11bb9d376e95d141ddd13468f0b7a)), memcopies and memsets for each buffer on a context.

The value is a size_t.

There is a limit on how many device buffers can be allocated per context. User can query and set this limit using the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_POOL_LIMIT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a3e84be3bdc3dc8a3477a56a1247287cc). CUPTI doesn’t pre-allocate all the buffers, it pre-allocates only those many buffers as set by the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_PRE_ALLOCATE_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a21f4deb586a4d759218e1d7f9530395f). When all of the data in a buffer is consumed, it is added in the reuse pool, and CUPTI picks a buffer from this pool when a new buffer is needed. Thus memory footprint does not scale with the kernel count. Applications with the high density of kernels, memcopies and memsets might result in having CUPTI to allocate more device buffers. CUPTI allocates another buffer only when it runs out of the buffers in the reuse pool.

Since buffer allocation happens in the main application thread, this might result in stalls in the critical path. CUPTI pre-allocates 3 buffers of the same size to mitigate this issue. User can query and set the pre-allocation limit using the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_PRE_ALLOCATE_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a21f4deb586a4d759218e1d7f9530395f).

Having larger buffer size leaves less device memory for the application. Having smaller buffer size increases the risk of dropping timestamps for records if too many kernels or memcopies or memsets are launched at one time.

This value only applies to new buffer allocations. Set this value before initializing CUDA or before creating a context to ensure it is considered for the following allocations.

The default value is 3200000 (~3MB) which can accommodate profiling data up to 100,000 kernels, memcopies and memsets combined.

Note: Starting with the CUDA 12.0 Update 1 release, CUPTI allocates the profiling buffer in the device memory by default, which may improve the performance of the tracing run. To change the preferred location to page-locked host memory, refer to the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_MEM_ALLOCATION_TYPE_HOST_PINNED](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a0baaaf2f89ee9a711b635ea3bc4b2e1e). The size of the memory and maximum number of pools are still controlled by the attributes [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_SIZE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6ad4ba37cb123069fa778513f87cbb4b37) and [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_POOL_LIMIT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a3e84be3bdc3dc8a3477a56a1247287cc).

Note: The actual amount of device memory per buffer reserved by CUPTI might be larger.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_SIZE_C.doc:
The device memory size (in bytes) reserved for storing profiling data for CDP operations for each buffer on a context.

The value is a size_t.

Having larger buffer size means less flush operations but consumes more device memory. This value only applies to new allocations.

Set this value before initializing CUDA or before creating a context to ensure it is considered for the following allocations.

The default value is 8388608 (8MB).

Note: The actual amount of device memory per context reserved by CUPTI might be larger.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_POOL_L.doc:
The maximum number of device memory buffers per context.

The value is a size_t.

For an application with high rate of kernel launches, memcopies and memsets having a bigger pool limit helps in timestamp collection for all these activities at the expense of a larger memory footprint. Refer to the description of the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_SIZE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6ad4ba37cb123069fa778513f87cbb4b37) for more details.

Setting this value will not modify the number of memory buffers currently stored.

Set this value before initializing CUDA to ensure the limit is not exceeded.

The default value is 250.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_.doc:
This attribute is not supported starting with CUDA 12.3 CUPTI no longer uses profiling semaphore pool to store profiling data.

There is a limit on how many semaphore pools can be allocated per context. User can query and set this limit using the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_POOL_LIMIT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6ad58f5aa6e9afbbcd2f7f7d6bd0896b8b). CUPTI doesn’t pre-allocate all the semaphore pools, it pre-allocates only those many semaphore pools as set by the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_PRE_ALLOCATE_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a52ecb99e83c0fa9da4bea4250089f3dd). When all of the data in a semaphore pool is consumed, it is added in the reuse pool, and CUPTI picks a semaphore pool from the reuse pool when a new semaphore pool is needed. Thus memory footprint does not scale with the kernel count. Applications with the high density of kernels might result in having CUPTI to allocate more semaphore pools. CUPTI allocates another semaphore pool only when it runs out of the semaphore pools in the reuse pool.

Since semaphore pool allocation happens in the main application thread, this might result in stalls in the critical path. CUPTI pre-allocates 3 semaphore pools of the same size to mitigate this issue. User can query and set the pre-allocation limit using the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_PRE_ALLOCATE_VALUE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a52ecb99e83c0fa9da4bea4250089f3dd).

Having larger semaphore pool size leaves less device memory for the application. Having smaller semaphore pool size increases the risk of dropping timestamps for kernel records if too many kernels are issued/launched at one time.

This value only applies to new semaphore pool allocations. Set this value before initializing CUDA or before creating a context to ensure it is considered for the following allocations.

The default value is 25000 which can accommodate profiling data for upto 25,000 kernels.

This attribute is not supported starting with CUDA 12.3 CUPTI no longer uses profiling semaphore pool to store profiling data.

The maximum number of profiling semaphore pools per context. The value is a size_t.

Refer to the description of the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_POOL_SIZE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a8ee6c22d0d55bb65700974bf9b1d75c2) for more details.

Set this value before initializing CUDA to ensure the limit is not exceeded.

The default value is 250.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ZEROED_OUT_ACTIVITY_.doc:
The flag to indicate whether user should provide activity buffer of zero value.

The value is a uint8_t.

If the value of this attribute is non-zero, user should provide a zero value buffer in the [CUpti_BuffersCallbackRequestFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga071f445bef24e41610fa79ca7d5a7d55). If the user does not provide a zero value buffer after setting this to non-zero, the activity buffer may contain some uninitialized values when CUPTI returns it in [CUpti_BuffersCallbackCompleteFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gae569889fa879df2dc9e6449b49445e77)

If the value of this attribute is zero, CUPTI will initialize the user buffer received in the [CUpti_BuffersCallbackRequestFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga071f445bef24e41610fa79ca7d5a7d55) to zero before filling it. If the user sets this to zero, a few stalls may appear in critical path because CUPTI will zero out the buffer in the main thread. Set this value before returning from [CUpti_BuffersCallbackRequestFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga071f445bef24e41610fa79ca7d5a7d55) to ensure it is considered for all the subsequent user buffers.

The default value is 0.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_PRE_AL.doc:
Number of device buffers to pre-allocate for a context during the initialization phase.

The value is a size_t.

Refer to the description of the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_SIZE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6ad4ba37cb123069fa778513f87cbb4b37) for details.

This value must be less than the maximum number of device buffers set using the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_POOL_LIMIT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a3e84be3bdc3dc8a3477a56a1247287cc)

Set this value before initializing CUDA or before creating a context to ensure it is considered by the CUPTI.

The default value is set to 3 to ping pong between these buffers (if possible).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_.doc:
This attribute is not supported starting with CUDA 12.3 CUPTI no longer uses profiling semaphore pool to store profiling data.

Number of profiling semaphore pools to pre-allocate for a context during the initialization phase. The value is a size_t.

Refer to the description of the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_POOL_SIZE](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6a8ee6c22d0d55bb65700974bf9b1d75c2) for details.

This value must be less than the maximum number of profiling semaphore pools set using the attribute [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PROFILING_SEMAPHORE_POOL_LIMIT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga1c31fe3f8ea0e46c6c20dd454a6caab6ad58f5aa6e9afbbcd2f7f7d6bd0896b8b)

Set this value before initializing CUDA or before creating a context to ensure it is considered by the CUPTI.

The default value is set to 3 to ping pong between these pools (if possible).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_MEM_ALLOCATION_TYPE_.doc:
Allocate page-locked (pinned) host memory for storing profiling data for concurrent kernels, memcopies and memsets for each buffer on a context.

The value is a uint8_t.

From CUDA 11.2 through CUDA 12.0 GA releases, CUPTI allocated the profiling buffer in pinned host memory by default. Allocating excessive amounts of pinned memory may degrade system performance, as it reduces the amount of memory available to the system for paging. For this reason user might want to change the location from pinned host memory to device memory by setting value of this attribute to 0.

Using page-locked (pinned) host memory buffers is not supported on confidential computing devices. If this attribute is set to 1, CUPTI will return error [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED`].

The default value is 0.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PER_THREAD_ACTIVITY_.doc:
Request activity buffers per-thread to store CUPTI activity records in the activity buffer on per-thread basis.

The value is a uint8_t.

The attribute should be set before registering the buffer callbacks using cuptiActivityRegisterCallbacks API and before any of the CUPTI activity kinds are enabled. This makes sure that all the records are stored in activity buffers allocated per-thread. Changing this attribute in the middle of the profiling session will result in undefined behavior.

The default value is 1.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_DEVICE_BUFFER_SIZE_D.doc:
The device memory size (in bytes) reserved for storing profiling data for device graph operations for each buffer on a context.

The value is a size_t.

Having larger buffer size means less flush operations but consumes more device memory. This value only applies to new allocations.

Set this value before initializing CUDA or before creating a context to ensure it is considered for the following allocations.

The default value is 16777216 (16MB).

Note: The actual amount of device memory per context reserved by CUPTI might be larger.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_USER_DEFINED_RECORDS.doc:
Enable user-defined activity records.

The value is a uint8_t.

When this attribute is enabled, CUPTI activity records will contain only the fields that are enabled for collection by the user. This can help to reduce the size of each activity record and decrease the overall memory consumption for activity collection.

This attribute must be set before enabling any CUPTI activity kinds. The activity kinds should be enabled/disabled using CUPTI API [cuptiActivityEnable_v2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga563584d948863ce4d7688847096149d2) and [cuptiActivityDisable_v2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga550569082abf3e8c017114881b9f7832) respectively.

Minimum CUPTI Version: CUPTI_API_VERSION 130200 (CUDA 13.2). The CUPTI version can be queried using [cuptiGetVersion()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__VERSION__API.html#group__cupti__version__api_1ga0e63a0d235c5e7e5231cc78ec63fa981) API.

Refer these links for online documentation: CUPTI Activity User-Defined Records: <https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/main/main.html#cupti-user-defined-activity-records> Tutorial: <https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/tutorial/tutorial.html#tutorial-activity-user-defined-records> Refer sample cupti_user_defined_records for usage.

The default value is 0 i.e. CUPTI will provide records with all fields.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_MULTIPLE_SUBSCRIBER_.doc:
Allow multiple subscribers.

The value is a uint8_t.

If 0, only a single subscriber is allowed. If 1, multiple subscribers are allowed. If 2, this option has not been set by a prior subscriber, if there were any. In this case, the subscriber is free to set it during cuptiSubscribe_v2 call. Note that this attribute cannot be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute or cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2. It can however be queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_HES.doc:
Get the HES (Hardware Events System) enabled flag.

The value is a uint8_t.

If 0, HES (Hardware Events System) is disabled. If 1, HES (Hardware Events System) is enabled. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2. This attribute is not subscriber specific, and the subscriber parameter is ignored. All subscribers will share the same HES enabled flag. However, this attribute must be set before enabling any activity kind by any subscriber. However, it can be queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_ALLOCATION_SO.doc:
Get the allocation source library tracking enabled flag (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a uint8_t.

If 0, allocation source library tracking is disabled. If 1, allocation source library tracking is enabled. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber. Note that the cuptiActivityEnableAllocationSource API cannot be used when multiple subscribers are allowed.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_KERNEL_LATENC.doc:
Get the latency timestamp tracking enabled flag (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a uint8_t.

This can be used to toggle collecting latency timestamps for kernel records.

If 0, latency timestamp tracking is disabled. If 1, latency timestamp tracking is enabled. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_ALL_SYNC_RECO.doc:
Get the all sync records enabled flag (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a uint8_t.

This can be used to toggle collecting sync records for all synchronization operations (whether to include records for synchronization operations which return non-zero CUDA status). By default, this flag is set to 0. If this flag is set to 1, sync records are collected for all synchronization operations (even if they return non-zero CUDA status). Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_CUDA_EVENT_DE.doc:
Get the event device timestamps enabled flag (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a uint8_t.

This can be used to toggle collecting event device timestamps for CUDA event records. By default, this flag is set to 0. If this flag is set to 1, event device timestamps are collected for CUDA event records. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_KERNEL_LAUNCH.doc:
Get the launch attributes for kernel enabled flag (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a uint8_t.

This can be used to toggle collecting launch attributes for kernel records. By default, this flag is set to 0. If this flag is set to 1, launch attributes are collected for kernel records. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_DEVICE_GRAPH_.doc:
Get the device graph trace enabled flag (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a uint8_t.

This can be used to toggle collecting device graph trace for graph records. By default, this flag is set to 0. If this flag is set to 1, device graph trace is collected for graph records. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_MULTI_SUBSCRI.doc:
Get the multi-subscriber graph level trace enabled flag.

The value is a uint8_t.

This attribute is only relevant for multi-subscriber mode. CUPTI currently does not support different subscribers to ask for node level trace and graph level trace concurrently. If this flag is disabled, body nodes of a graph are reported under normal concurrent kernel/ memcpy/ memset records. If this flag is enabled, body nodes of a graph are not reported under normal concurrent kernel/ memcpy/ memset records, but the graph is entirely reported as part of a single graph trace record(if [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`] is enabled for the subscriber). Note that this behavior is consistent across all subscribers, regardless of which activities each subscriber is enabling.

If 0, multi-subscriber graph level trace is disabled. If 1, multi-subscriber graph level trace is enabled. The default value is 0. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber. However, this attribute must be set before enabling any activity kind by any subscriber. This attribute is not subscriber specific, and the subscriber parameter is ignored. All subscribers will share the same multi-subscriber graph level trace enabled flag.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_THREAD_ID_TYPE.doc:
Get or set the thread ID type (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a CUpti_ActivityThreadIdType.

This attribute specifies the method used by CUPTI to obtain thread IDs. The default value is [`CUpti_ActivityThreadIdType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_THREAD_ID_TYPE_DEFAULT`]. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_TIMESTAMP_CALLBACK.doc:
Get or set the timestamp callback function (for the specified subscriber).

The value is a CUpti_TimestampCallbackFunc.

This attribute allows registering a custom timestamp callback function that CUPTI will use instead of its default CPU timer. The value can be NULL to unregister the callback. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2 for the specified subscriber.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_ENABLE_CIG_MODE.doc:
Get or set the CIG (CUDA in Graphics) mode.

The value is a uint8_t.

This attribute allows enabling or disabling the CIG mode. Note that this attribute can be set by cuptiActivitySetAttribute_v2 and queried using cuptiActivityGetAttribute_v2.

CUpti_ActivityComputeApiKind.doc: The kind of a compute API.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_COMPUTE_API_UNKNOWN.doc: The compute API is not known.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_COMPUTE_API_CUDA.doc: The compute APIs are for CUDA.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_COMPUTE_API_CUDA_MPS.doc: The compute APIs are for CUDA running in MPS (Multi-Process Service) environment.

CUpti_ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitchFiel.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch.html#structcupti__activitycomputeenginectxswitch).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch.html#structcupti__activitycomputeenginectxswitch) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH`].

COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_FIELD_CONTEXT_.doc: uint32_t contextId; ID of the CUDA context.

COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_FIELD_TIMESTAM.doc: uint64_t timestamp; Timestamp at which the context switch operation occurs.

COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_FIELD_OPERATIO.doc: CUpti_ComputeEngineCtxSwitchOperationType operationType; Type of the Compute Engine Context switch operation.

CUpti_ActivityConfidentialComputeRotatio.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityConfidentialComputeRotation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityConfidentialComputeRotation.html#structcupti__activityconfidentialcomputerotation).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityConfidentialComputeRotation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityConfidentialComputeRotation.html#structcupti__activityconfidentialcomputerotation) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE_ROTATION_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE_ROTATION`].

CUpti_ActivityContextFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace context.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`].

CONTEXT_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`].

CONTEXT_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; The ID of the context.

CONTEXT_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; The ID of the device associated with the context.

CONTEXT_FIELD_COMPUTE_API_KIND.doc:
uint16_t computeApiKind; The compute API kind associated with the context.

[CUpti_ActivityComputeApiKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaf46dcec421da358ab4e9edad76774179).

CONTEXT_FIELD_NULL_STREAM_ID.doc: uint32_t nullStreamId; The ID for the NULL stream in this context.

CONTEXT_FIELD_PARENT_CONTEXT_ID.doc:
uint32_t parentContextId; The ID of the parent context.

It would be 0 if context does not have parent.

CONTEXT_FIELD_IS_GREEN_CONTEXT.doc: uint8_t isGreenContext; Indicates whether the context is a green context.

CONTEXT_FIELD_NUM_MULTIPROCESSORS.doc:
uint16_t numMultiprocessors; Number of multiprocessors assigned to the green context.

Invalid if the field ‘isGreenContext’ is 0.

CONTEXT_FIELD_CIG_MODE.doc: CUpti_ContextCigMode cigMode; The CIG mode of the context.

CONTEXT_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; The ID of the process associated with the context.

CUpti_ActivityCudaEventFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace CUDA Event operations.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CUDA_EVENT`].

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`].

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this CUDA Event operation.

Matches the correlation ID in the CUDA driver/runtime API activity record that launched it.

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; The ID of the context where the event was recorded.

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc: uint32_t streamId; The compute stream where the event was recorded.

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_EVENT_ID.doc: uint64_t eventId; A unique event ID to identify the event record.

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; The ID of the device where the event was recorded.

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_DEVICE_TIMESTAMP.doc:
uint64_t deviceTimestamp; The device-side timestamp on CUDA event record (in nanoseconds).

Collection of this field is disabled by default. It can be enabled by calling CUPTI API [cuptiActivityEnableCudaEventDeviceTimestamps](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga86a82dd4c053b885030dc12863c4b209).

CUDA_EVENT_FIELD_CUDA_EVENT_SYNC_ID.doc:
uint64_t cudaEventSyncId; A unique ID to associate event synchronization records with the latest CUDA Event record.

Similar field is added in [CUpti_ActivitySynchronization2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySynchronization2.html#structcupti__activitysynchronization2) to associate CUDA Event record to the synchronization record.

The same CUDA event can be used multiple times, so the event id will not be unique to correlate the synchronization record with the latest CUDA Event record. This field will be unique and can be used to do the required correlation.

CUpti_ActivityDeviceFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

DEVICE_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`].

DEVICE_FIELD_FLAGS.doc: CUpti_ActivityFlag flags; Flags associated with the device.

DEVICE_FIELD_GLOBAL_MEMORY_BANDWIDTH.doc: uint64_t globalMemoryBandwidth; Global memory bandwidth available on the device (in kBytes/sec).

DEVICE_FIELD_GLOBAL_MEMORY_SIZE.doc: uint64_t globalMemorySize; Amount of global memory on the device (in bytes).

DEVICE_FIELD_CONSTANT_MEMORY_SIZE.doc: uint32_t constantMemorySize; Amount of constant memory on the device (in bytes).

DEVICE_FIELD_L2_CACHE_SIZE.doc: uint32_t l2CacheSize; Size of the L2 cache on the device (in bytes).

DEVICE_FIELD_NUM_THREADS_PER_WARP.doc: uint32_t numThreadsPerWarp; Number of threads per warp on the device.

DEVICE_FIELD_CORE_CLOCK_RATE.doc: uint32_t coreClockRate; Core clock rate of the device (in kHz).

DEVICE_FIELD_NUM_MEMCPY_ENGINES.doc: uint32_t numMemcpyEngines; Number of memory copy engines on the device.

DEVICE_FIELD_NUM_MULTIPROCESSORS.doc: uint32_t numMultiprocessors; Number of multiprocessors on the device.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_IPC.doc: uint32_t maxIPC; Maximum instructions per cycle possible on each device multiprocessor.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_WARPS_PER_MULTIPROCESSO.doc: uint32_t maxWarpsPerMultiprocessor; Maximum number of warps that can be present on a multiprocessor.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_BLOCKS_PER_MULTIPROCESS.doc: uint32_t maxBlocksPerMultiprocessor; Maximum number of blocks that can be present on a multiprocessor.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_SHARED_MEMORY_PER_MULTI.doc: uint32_t maxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor; Maximum amount of shared memory available per multiprocessor (in bytes).

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_REGISTERS_PER_MULTIPROC.doc: uint32_t maxRegistersPerMultiprocessor; Maximum number of 32-bit registers available per multiprocessor.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_REGISTERS_PER_BLOCK.doc: uint32_t maxRegistersPerBlock; Maximum number of registers that can be allocated to a block.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_SHARED_MEMORY_PER_BLOCK.doc: uint32_t maxSharedMemoryPerBlock; Maximum amount of shared memory that can be assigned to a block (in bytes).

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_THREADS_PER_BLOCK.doc: uint32_t maxThreadsPerBlock; Maximum number of threads allowed in a block.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_BLOCK_DIM_X.doc: uint32_t maxBlockDimX; Maximum allowed X dimension for a block.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_BLOCK_DIM_Y.doc: uint32_t maxBlockDimY; Maximum allowed Y dimension for a block.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_BLOCK_DIM_Z.doc: uint32_t maxBlockDimZ; Maximum allowed Z dimension for a block.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_GRID_DIM_X.doc: uint32_t maxGridDimX; Maximum allowed X dimension for a grid.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_GRID_DIM_Y.doc: uint32_t maxGridDimY; Maximum allowed Y dimension for a grid.

DEVICE_FIELD_MAX_GRID_DIM_Z.doc: uint32_t maxGridDimZ; Maximum allowed Z dimension for a grid.

DEVICE_FIELD_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY_MAJOR.doc: uint32_t computeCapabilityMajor; Compute capability for the device (major number).

DEVICE_FIELD_COMPUTE_CAPABILITY_MINOR.doc: uint32_t computeCapabilityMinor; Compute capability for the device (minor number).

DEVICE_FIELD_ECC_ENABLED.doc: uint32_t eccEnabled; ECC enabled flag for device.

DEVICE_FIELD_IS_CUDA_VISIBLE.doc: uint8_t isCudaVisible; Flag to indicate whether the device is visible to CUDA.

DEVICE_FIELD_IS_MIG_ENABLED.doc: uint8_t isMigEnabled; MIG enabled flag for device.

DEVICE_FIELD_GPU_INSTANCE_ID.doc: uint32_t gpuInstanceId; GPU instance ID for MIG enabled devices.

DEVICE_FIELD_COMPUTE_INSTANCE_ID.doc: uint32_t computeInstanceId; Compute instance ID for MIG enabled devices.

DEVICE_FIELD_IS_NUMA_NODE.doc: uint32_t isNumaNode; NUMA node flag for device.

DEVICE_FIELD_NUMA_ID.doc: uint32_t numaId; NUMA node ID of the GPU memory.

DEVICE_FIELD_NUM_TPCS.doc: uint32_t numTpcs; Number of TPCs on the device.

CUpti_ActivityDeviceGraphTraceFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityDeviceGraphTrace](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDeviceGraphTrace.html#structcupti__activitydevicegraphtrace).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityDeviceGraphTrace](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDeviceGraphTrace.html#structcupti__activitydevicegraphtrace) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE`].

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; ID of the device where the first node of the graph is executed.

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; Start timestamp for the graph execution (in ns).

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; End timestamp for the graph execution (in ns).

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_GRAPH_ID.doc: uint32_t graphId; Unique ID of the graph that is launched.

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_LAUNCHER_GRAPH_.doc: uint32_t launcherGraphId; Unique ID of the graph that has launched this graph.

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint64_t contextId; ID of the context where the first node of the graph is executed.

DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc:
uint64_t streamId; ID of the stream where the graph is being launched.

This is the only record that has 64-bit streamId to accommodate device-side created streams.

CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityEnvironment](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironment.html#structcupti__activityenvironment).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityEnvironment](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironment.html#structcupti__activityenvironment) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

ENVIRONMENT_FIELD_KIND.doc: CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of activity record: [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_ENVIRONMENT`].

ENVIRONMENT_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; The ID of the device.

ENVIRONMENT_FIELD_TIMESTAMP.doc:
uint64_t timestamp; The timestamp when this sample was retrieved, in ns.

A value of 0 indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the marker.

ENVIRONMENT_FIELD_ENVIRONMENT_KIND.doc: CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind environmentKind; The kind of data reported in this record.

ENVIRONMENT_FIELD_ENVIRONMENT_KIND_DATA.doc:
union data; Depending on the value of environmentKind, this field contains additional information about the environment.

[CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentSpeed](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironmentSpeed.html#structcupti__activityenvironmentspeed) speed if environmentKind is [`CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_SPEED`] [CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentTemperature](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironmentTemperature.html#structcupti__activityenvironmenttemperature) temperature if environmentKind is [`CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_TEMPERATURE`] [CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentPower](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironmentPower.html#structcupti__activityenvironmentpower) power if environmentKind is [`CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_POWER`] [CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentCooling](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironmentCooling.html#structcupti__activityenvironmentcooling) cooling if environmentKind is [`CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_COOLING`] The size of this field is determined by the largest structure among the possible types it can hold.

CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind.doc:
The kind of environment data.

Used to indicate what type of data is being reported by an environment activity record.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_SPEED.doc: The environment data is related to speed.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_TEMPERATURE.doc: The environment data is related to temperature.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_POWER.doc: The environment data is related to power.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_COOLING.doc: The environment data is related to cooling.

CUpti_ActivityExternalCorrelationFieldId.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityExternalCorrelation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityExternalCorrelation.html#structcupti__activityexternalcorrelation).

This activity record correlates native CUDA records (e.g. CUDA Driver API, kernels, memcpys, …) with records from external APIs such as OpenACC. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION`]).

EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION`].

EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_FIELD_EXTERNAL_KIND.doc: CUpti_ExternalCorrelationKind externalKind; Kind of external API this record correlated to.

EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_FIELD_EXTERNAL_ID.doc: uint64_t externalId; Correlation ID of the associated non-CUDA API record.

EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_FIELD_CORRELATION_I.doc: uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID of the associated CUDA driver or runtime API record.

CUpti_ActivityFlag.doc:
Flags associated with activity records.

Activity record flags. Flags can be combined by bitwise OR to associated multiple flags with an activity record. Each flag is specific to a certain activity kind, as noted below.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_NONE.doc: Indicates the activity record has no flags.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_DEVICE_CONCURRENT_KE.doc:
Indicates the activity represents a device that supports concurrent kernel execution.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_CUD.doc:
Indicates if the activity represents a CUdevice_attribute value or a CUpti_DeviceAttribute value.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MEMCPY_ASYNC.doc:
Indicates the activity represents an asynchronous memcpy operation.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_INSTANTANEOUS.doc:
Indicates the activity represents an instantaneous marker.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_START.doc:
Indicates the activity represents a region start marker.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_END.doc:
Indicates the activity represents a region end marker.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_SYNC_ACQUIRE.doc:
Indicates the activity represents an attempt to acquire a user defined synchronization object.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_SYNC_ACQUIRE_.doc:
Indicates the activity represents success in acquiring the user defined synchronization object.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

Indicates the activity represents failure in acquiring the user defined synchronization object.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_SYNC_RELEASE.doc:
Indicates the activity represents releasing a reservation on user defined synchronization object.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_COLOR_NONE.doc:
Indicates the activity represents a marker that does not specify a color.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MARKER_COLOR_ARGB.doc:
Indicates the activity represents a marker that specifies a color in alpha-red-green-blue format.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_GLOBAL_ACCESS_KIND_S.doc: The number of bytes requested by each thread Valid for [CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGlobalAccess3.html#structcupti__activityglobalaccess3).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_GLOBAL_ACCESS_KIND_L.doc:
If bit in this flag is set, the access was load, else it is a store access.

Valid for [CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGlobalAccess3.html#structcupti__activityglobalaccess3).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_GLOBAL_ACCESS_KIND_C.doc:
If this bit in flag is set, the load access was cached else it is uncached.

Valid for [CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGlobalAccess3.html#structcupti__activityglobalaccess3).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_METRIC_OVERFLOWED.doc:
If this bit in flag is set, the metric value overflowed.

Valid for [CUpti_ActivityMetric](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMetric.html#structcupti__activitymetric) and [CUpti_ActivityMetricInstance](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMetricInstance.html#structcupti__activitymetricinstance).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_METRIC_VALUE_INVALID.doc:
If this bit in flag is set, the metric value couldn’t be calculated.

This occurs when a value(s) required to calculate the metric is missing. Valid for [CUpti_ActivityMetric](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMetric.html#structcupti__activitymetric) and [CUpti_ActivityMetricInstance](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMetricInstance.html#structcupti__activitymetricinstance).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_INSTRUCTION_VALUE_IN.doc:
If this bit in flag is set, the source level metric value couldn’t be calculated.

This occurs when a value(s) required to calculate the source level metric cannot be evaluated. Valid for [CUpti_ActivityInstructionExecution](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstructionExecution.html#structcupti__activityinstructionexecution).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_INSTRUCTION_CLASS_MA.doc: The mask for the instruction class, [CUpti_ActivityInstructionClass](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gabb6c00413aa3491f7da9e9cbbecf4133) Valid for [CUpti_ActivityInstructionExecution](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstructionExecution.html#structcupti__activityinstructionexecution) and [CUpti_ActivityInstructionCorrelation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstructionCorrelation.html#structcupti__activityinstructioncorrelation).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_FLUSH_FORCED.doc: When calling cuptiActivityFlushAll, this flag can be set to force CUPTI to flush all records in the buffer, whether finished or not.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_SHARED_ACCESS_KIND_S.doc: The number of bytes requested by each thread Valid for [CUpti_ActivitySharedAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySharedAccess.html#structcupti__activitysharedaccess).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_SHARED_ACCESS_KIND_L.doc:
If bit in this flag is set, the access was load, else it is a store access.

Valid for [CUpti_ActivitySharedAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySharedAccess.html#structcupti__activitysharedaccess).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_MEMSET_ASYNC.doc:
Indicates the activity represents an asynchronous memset operation.

Valid for [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_THRASHING_IN_CPU.doc:
Indicates the activity represents thrashing in CPU.

Valid for counter of kind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] in [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`].

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_THROTTLING_IN_CPU.doc:
Indicates the activity represents page throttling in CPU.

Valid for counter of kind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`] in [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`].

CUpti_ActivityGraphHostNodeFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in CUpti_ActivityGraphHostNode.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_KIND.doc:

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc: uint32_t streamId; ID of the stream that waits for the graph host node to finish.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; ID of the CUDA device to which the CUDA context and stream belong.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc: uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID of the graph host node operation.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_GRAPH_ID.doc: uint32_t graphId; Unique ID of the graph that executed this host node through graph launch.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_GRAPH_NODE_ID.doc: uint64_t graphNodeId; Unique ID of the graph node that executed this host node through graph launch.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; ID of the process where the host node is executing.

GRAPH_HOST_NODE_FIELD_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t threadId; ID of the thread where the host node is executing.

CUpti_ActivityGraphTraceFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace graph execution.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`].

GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`].

GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc: uint64_t correlationId; The correlation ID of the graph launch.

GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; The start timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; The end timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

uint32_t deviceId; The ID of the device where the first node of the graph is executed.

GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_GRAPH_ID.doc: uint32_t graphId; The unique ID of the graph that is launched.

uint32_t contextId; The ID of the context where the first node of the graph is executed.

If this is INT_MAX, then the start is on the host.

GRAPH_TRACE_FIELD_END_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t endContextId; The ID of the context where the last node of the graph is executed.

CUpti_ActivityGreenContextFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace green context information.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`].

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`].

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; The context ID of the green context.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; The device ID associated with the green context.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_NUM_MULTIPROCESSORS.doc: uint16_t numMultiprocessors; The number of multiprocessors (SMs) allocated to the green context.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_NUM_TPCS.doc: uint32_t numTpcs; The number of TPCs allocated to the green context.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_LOGICAL_TPC_MASK_SIZ.doc: uint8_t logicalTpcMaskSize; The size (in 32-bit words) of the logical TPC mask.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_LOGICAL_TPC_MASK.doc: uint32_t logicalTpcMask[32]; The logical TPC mask for the green context.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_WORKQUEUE_RESOURCE_I.doc:

Refer.

GREEN_CONTEXT_FIELD_WORKQUEUE_SHARING_SC.doc: uint32_t workqueueSharingScope; The sharing scope for the work queue associated with the green context.

CUpti_ActivityHostLaunchFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityHostLaunch](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityHostLaunch.html#structcupti__activityhostlaunch).

HOST_LAUNCH_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; ID of the CUDA context to which the waiting CUDA stream belongs.

HOST_LAUNCH_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; ID of the CUDA device to which the CUDA context and stream belong.

HOST_LAUNCH_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; ID of the process where the host function is executing.

HOST_LAUNCH_FIELD_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t threadId; ID of the thread where the host function is executing.

CUpti_ActivityInstructionClass.doc:
SASS instruction classification.

The sass instruction are broadly divided into different class. Each enum represents a classification.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_INSTRUCTION_CLASS_UNKNOWN.doc: The instruction class is not known.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_INSTRUCTION_CLASS_FP_32.doc: Represents a 32 bit floating point operation.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_INSTRUCTION_CLASS_FP_64.doc: Represents a 64 bit floating point operation.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_INSTRUCTION_CLASS_MISCELL.doc: Represents some miscellaneous instructions which do not fit in the above classification.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_INSTRUCTION_CLASS_FP_16.doc: Represents a 16 bit floating point operation.

CUpti_ActivityJitEntryType.doc:
The types of JIT entry.

To be used in [CUpti_ActivityJit](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityJit.html#structcupti__activityjit).

CUpti_ActivityJitFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace JIT operations.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_JIT`].

JIT_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_JIT`].

JIT_FIELD_ENTRY_TYPE.doc:
CUpti_ActivityJitEntryType jitEntryType; The JIT entry type.

[CUpti_ActivityJitEntryType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga0367503f3fc0af7b3c5051a9408efa80).

JIT_FIELD_OPERATION_TYPE.doc:
CUpti_ActivityJitOperationType jitOperationType; The JIT operation type.

[CUpti_ActivityJitOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga2dc4ccb146a37875b3d8564b8100e59a).

JIT_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; The start timestamp for the JIT operation (in nanoseconds).

JIT_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; The end timestamp for the JIT operation (in nanoseconds).

JIT_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this JIT operation.

Matches the correlation ID in the CUDA driver/runtime API activity record that launched it.

JIT_FIELD_OPERATION_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t jitOperationCorrelationId; The correlation ID to correlate JIT compilation, load and store operations.

Each JIT compilation unit is assigned a unique correlation ID at the time of the JIT compilation. This correlation id can be used to find the matching JIT cache load/store records.

JIT_FIELD_CACHE_SIZE.doc: uint64_t cacheSize; The size of compute cache.

JIT_FIELD_CACHE_PATH.doc: const char\* cachePath; The path where the fat binary is cached.

JIT_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; The ID of the process where the JIT operation is executing.

JIT_FIELD_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t threadId; The ID of the thread where the JIT operation is executing.

CUpti_ActivityJitOperationType.doc:
The types of JIT compilation operations.

To be used in [CUpti_ActivityJit](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityJit.html#structcupti__activityjit).

CUpti_ActivityKernelFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace kernel operations.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

KERNEL_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always either [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

KERNEL_FIELD_CACHE_CONFIG_REQUESTED.doc:
uint8_t requested; Indicates the cache configuration requested by the kernel.

Values are from CUfunc_cache enumeration.

KERNEL_FIELD_CACHE_CONFIG_EXECUTED.doc:
uint8_t executed; Indicates the cache configuration actually used during kernel execution.

Values are from CUfunc_cache enumeration.

KERNEL_FIELD_SHARED_MEMORY_CONFIG.doc:
uint8_t sharedMemoryConfig; Specifies the shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

Values are from CUsharedconfig enumeration.

KERNEL_FIELD_REGISTERS_PER_THREAD.doc: uint16_t registersPerThread; Number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_PARTITIONED_GLOBAL_CACHE_RE.doc:
CUpti_ActivityPartitionedGlobalCacheConfig requested; Partitioned global caching requested for the kernel.

Relevant for devices requiring this to enable caching.

KERNEL_FIELD_PARTITIONED_GLOBAL_CACHE_EX.doc: CUpti_ActivityPartitionedGlobalCacheConfig executed; Partitioned global caching actually used during kernel execution.

KERNEL_FIELD_START.doc:
uint64_t start; Start timestamp for the kernel execution (in nanoseconds).

A value of 0 indicates timestamp couldn’t be collected.

KERNEL_FIELD_END.doc:
uint64_t end; End timestamp for the kernel execution (in nanoseconds).

A value of 0 indicates timestamp couldn’t be collected.

KERNEL_FIELD_COMPLETED.doc:
uint64_t completed; Completion timestamp for the kernel execution, including all child kernels (in nanoseconds).

CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN if unknown.

KERNEL_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

KERNEL_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint64_t contextId; ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

KERNEL_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc: uint64_t streamId; ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

KERNEL_FIELD_GRID_X.doc: int32_t gridX; X-dimension of the grid size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_GRID_Y.doc: int32_t gridY; Y-dimension of the grid size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_GRID_Z.doc: int32_t gridZ; Z-dimension of the grid size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_BLOCK_X.doc: int32_t blockX; X-dimension of the block size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_BLOCK_Y.doc: int32_t blockY; Y-dimension of the block size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_BLOCK_Z.doc: int32_t blockZ; Z-dimension of the block size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_STATIC_SHARED_MEMORY.doc: int32_t staticSharedMemory; Amount of static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

KERNEL_FIELD_DYNAMIC_SHARED_MEMORY.doc: int32_t dynamicSharedMemory; Amount of dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

KERNEL_FIELD_LOCAL_MEMORY_PER_THREAD.doc: uint32_t localMemoryPerThread; Amount of local memory reserved per thread, in bytes.

KERNEL_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc: uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID of the kernel, Matches the correlation ID in the CUDA driver/runtime API activity record that launched it.

KERNEL_FIELD_GRID_ID.doc: int64_t gridId; Unique grid ID assigned to the kernel at runtime.

KERNEL_FIELD_NAME.doc:
const char\* name; Name of the kernel.

Shared across all activity records for the same kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_QUEUED.doc:
uint64_t queued; Timestamp when the kernel was queued in the command buffer (in nanoseconds).

CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN if not collected.

KERNEL_FIELD_SUBMITTED.doc:
uint64_t submitted; Timestamp when the command buffer containing the kernel launch was submitted to the GPU (in nanoseconds).

CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN if not collected.

KERNEL_FIELD_LAUNCH_TYPE.doc:
uint8_t launchType; Indicates if the kernel was executed via a regular launch or a cooperative launch.

See CUpti_ActivityLaunchType.

KERNEL_FIELD_IS_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT_R.doc: uint8_t isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested; Indicates if CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT was updated for the kernel launch.

KERNEL_FIELD_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT_REQU.doc: uint8_t sharedMemoryCarveoutRequested; Shared memory carveout value requested for the function, as a percentage of the total resource.

KERNEL_FIELD_SHARED_MEMORY_EXECUTED.doc: uint32_t sharedMemoryExecuted; Shared memory size set by the driver, in bytes.

KERNEL_FIELD_GRAPH_NODE_ID.doc:
uint64_t graphNodeId; Unique ID of the graph node that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

0 if not launched through graph APIs.

KERNEL_FIELD_SHMEM_LIMIT_CONFIG.doc: CUpti_FuncShmemLimitConfig shmemLimitConfig; Shared memory limit configuration for the kernel, indicating if a higher per-block dynamic shared memory limit was opted.

KERNEL_FIELD_GRAPH_ID.doc:
uint32_t graphId; Unique ID of the graph that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

0 if not launched through graph APIs.

KERNEL_FIELD_ACCESS_POLICY_WINDOW.doc:
CUaccessPolicyWindow\* pAccessPolicyWindow; Pointer to the access policy window structure.

Defined in cuda.h.

KERNEL_FIELD_CHANNEL_ID.doc: uint32_t channelID; ID of the hardware channel on which the kernel is launched.

KERNEL_FIELD_CHANNEL_TYPE.doc: CUpti_ChannelType channelType; Type of the channel used for kernel launch.

KERNEL_FIELD_CLUSTER_X.doc:
int32_t clusterX; X-dimension of the cluster size for the kernel.

Valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

KERNEL_FIELD_CLUSTER_Y.doc:
int32_t clusterY; Y-dimension of the cluster size for the kernel.

Valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

KERNEL_FIELD_CLUSTER_Z.doc:
int32_t clusterZ; Z-dimension of the cluster size for the kernel.

Valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

KERNEL_FIELD_CLUSTER_SCHEDULING_POLICY.doc:
uint32_t clusterSchedulingPolicy; Cluster scheduling policy for the kernel.

Refer to CUclusterSchedulingPolicy. Valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

KERNEL_FIELD_LOCAL_MEMORY_TOTAL.doc: uint64_t localMemoryTotal_v2; Total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

KERNEL_FIELD_MAX_POTENTIAL_CLUSTER_SIZE.doc: uint32_t maxPotentialClusterSize; Maximum cluster size for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_MAX_ACTIVE_CLUSTERS.doc: uint32_t maxActiveClusters; Maximum number of clusters that could co-exist on the target device for the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_IS_DEVICE_LAUNCHED.doc: uint8_t isDeviceLaunched; This field is set to 1 if the kernel is part of a device launched graph.

KERNEL_FIELD_LAUNCH_PRIORITY.doc: int32_t priority; The launch priority of the kernel.

KERNEL_FIELD_EXECUTION_MODEL.doc:
uint32_t executionModel; The execution model of the kernel function.

See also

[CUpti_FuncExecutionModel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaf6d8c1b48d630571b8c2551d8e1f8c5a) for possible values.
