CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY.doc:
A host<->host, host<->device, or device<->device memory copy.

For peer to peer memory copy, use the kind [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`]. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemcpy6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemcpy6.html#structcupti__activitymemcpy6).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET.doc:
A memory set executing on the GPU.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemset4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemset4.html#structcupti__activitymemset4).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL.doc:
A kernel executing on the GPU.

This activity kind may significantly change the overall performance characteristics of the application because all kernel executions are serialized on the GPU. Other activity kind for kernel [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`] doesn’t break kernel concurrency. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityKernel12](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel12.html#structcupti__activitykernel12).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DRIVER.doc:
A CUDA driver API function execution.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME.doc:
A CUDA runtime API function execution.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT.doc:
A performance counter (aka event) value.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityEvent](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEvent.html#structcupti__activityevent). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Event API. can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC.doc:
A performance metric value.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMetric](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMetric.html#structcupti__activitymetric). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Metric API. can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE.doc:
Information about a CUDA device.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT.doc:
Information about a CUDA context.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityContext4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityContext4.html#structcupti__activitycontext4).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL.doc:
A kernel executing on the GPU.

This activity kind doesn’t break kernel concurrency. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityKernel12](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel12.html#structcupti__activitykernel12).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NAME.doc:
Resource naming done via NVTX APIs for thread, device, context, etc.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityName](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityName.html#structcupti__activityname).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER.doc:
Instantaneous, start, or end NVTX marker.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMarker2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMarker2.html#structcupti__activitymarker2).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA.doc:
Extended, optional, data about a NVTX marker.

User must enable [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`] as well to get records for marker data. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMarkerData2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMarkerData2.html#structcupti__activitymarkerdata2).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SOURCE_LOCATOR.doc:
Source information about source level result.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivitySourceLocator](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySourceLocator.html#structcupti__activitysourcelocator). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the SASS Metric APIs from the cupti_sass_metrics.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GLOBAL_ACCESS.doc:
Results for source-level global access.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGlobalAccess3.html#structcupti__activityglobalaccess3). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the SASS Metric APIs from the cupti_sass_metrics.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_BRANCH.doc:
Results for source-level branch.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityBranch2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityBranch2.html#structcupti__activitybranch2). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the SASS Metric APIs from the cupti_sass_metrics.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OVERHEAD.doc:
Overhead added by CUPTI, Compiler, CUDA driver etc.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityOverhead3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOverhead3.html#structcupti__activityoverhead3).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CDP_KERNEL.doc:
A CDP (CUDA Dynamic Parallel) kernel executing on the GPU.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityCdpKernel](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityCdpKernel.html#structcupti__activitycdpkernel). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. It is enabled and disabled through concurrent kernel activity i.e. _CONCURRENT_KERNEL.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PREEMPTION.doc:
Preemption activity record indicating a preemption of a CDP (CUDA Dynamic Parallel) kernel executing on the GPU.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityPreemption](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPreemption.html#structcupti__activitypreemption).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_ENVIRONMENT.doc:
Environment activity records indicating power, clock, thermal, etc.

levels of the GPU. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityEnvironment](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEnvironment.html#structcupti__activityenvironment).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT_INSTANCE.doc:
An performance counter value associated with a specific event domain instance.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityEventInstance](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityEventInstance.html#structcupti__activityeventinstance). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Event API. can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2.doc:
A peer to peer memory copy.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemcpyPtoP4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemcpyPtoP4.html#structcupti__activitymemcpyptop4).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC_INSTANCE.doc:
A performance metric value associated with a specific metric domain instance.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMetricInstance](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMetricInstance.html#structcupti__activitymetricinstance). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Metric API. can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTRUCTION_EXECUTIO.doc:
Results for source-level instruction execution.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityInstructionExecution](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstructionExecution.html#structcupti__activityinstructionexecution). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the SASS Metric APIs from the cupti_sass_metrics.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNT.doc:
Unified Memory counter record.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3.html#structcupti__activityunifiedmemorycounter3).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_FUNCTION.doc:
Device global/function record.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityFunction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityFunction.html#structcupti__activityfunction).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MODULE.doc:
CUDA Module record.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityModule](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityModule.html#structcupti__activitymodule). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the module callback can be stored in the corresponding activity record.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE.doc:
A device attribute value.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityDeviceAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDeviceAttribute.html#structcupti__activitydeviceattribute). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using attributes CUpti_DeviceAttribute or CUdevice_attribute can be stored in the corresponding activity record.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SHARED_ACCESS.doc:
Results for source-level shared access.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivitySharedAccess](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySharedAccess.html#structcupti__activitysharedaccess). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the SASS Metric APIs from the cupti_sass_metrics.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING.doc:
PC sampling information for kernels.

This will serialize kernels. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityPCSampling3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPCSampling3.html#structcupti__activitypcsampling3). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the PC Sampling API from the cupti_pcsampling.h header, which allows concurrent kernel execution.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING_RECORD_I.doc:
Summary information about PC sampling records.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingRecordInfo](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPCSamplingRecordInfo.html#structcupti__activitypcsamplingrecordinfo). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the PC Sampling API from the cupti_pcsampling.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTRUCTION_CORRELAT.doc:
SASS/Source line-by-line correlation record.

This will generate sass/source correlation for functions that have source level analysis or pc sampling results. The records will be generated only when either of source level analysis or pc sampling activity is enabled. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityInstructionCorrelation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstructionCorrelation.html#structcupti__activityinstructioncorrelation). Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used. Enabling it will return the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`]. Instead, use the SASS Metric APIs from the cupti_sass_metrics.h header.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_DATA.doc:
OpenACC data events.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityOpenAccData](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAccData.html#structcupti__activityopenaccdata).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_LAUNCH.doc:
OpenACC launch events.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityOpenAccLaunch](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAccLaunch.html#structcupti__activityopenacclaunch).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_OTHER.doc:
OpenACC other events.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityOpenAccOther](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAccOther.html#structcupti__activityopenaccother).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CUDA_EVENT.doc:
Information about a CUDA event (cudaEvent).

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityCudaEvent2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityCudaEvent2.html#structcupti__activitycudaevent2).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_STREAM.doc:
Information about a CUDA stream.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityStream](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityStream.html#structcupti__activitystream).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SYNCHRONIZATION.doc:
Records for CUDA synchronization primitives.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivitySynchronization2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySynchronization2.html#structcupti__activitysynchronization2).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION.doc:
Records for correlation of different programming APIs.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityExternalCorrelation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityExternalCorrelation.html#structcupti__activityexternalcorrelation).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NVLINK.doc:
NVLink topology information.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityNvLink5](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityNvLink5.html#structcupti__activitynvlink5).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_EVENT.doc:
Instantaneous Event information.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousEvent](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstantaneousEvent.html#structcupti__activityinstantaneousevent). This activity can not be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Event API can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_EVENT_.doc:
Instantaneous Event information for a specific event domain instance.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousEventInstance](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstantaneousEventInstance.html#structcupti__activityinstantaneouseventinstance). This activity can not be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Event API can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_METRIC.doc:
Instantaneous Metric information The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousMetric](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstantaneousMetric.html#structcupti__activityinstantaneousmetric).

This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Metric API can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

Instantaneous Metric information for a specific metric domain instance.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousMetricInstance](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityInstantaneousMetricInstance.html#structcupti__activityinstantaneousmetricinstance). This activity cannot be directly enabled or disabled. Information collected using the Metric API can be stored in the corresponding activity record. Starting with the CUDA 13.0 release, this enum is unsupported and should no longer be used.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY.doc: Memory activity tracking allocation and freeing of the memory The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemory](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory.html#structcupti__activitymemory).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PCIE.doc:
PCI devices information used for PCI topology.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityPcie](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPcie.html#structcupti__activitypcie).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENMP.doc:
OpenMP parallel events.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityOpenMp](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenMp.html#structcupti__activityopenmp).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INTERNAL_LAUNCH_API.doc:
A CUDA driver kernel launch occurring outside of any public API function execution.

Tools can handle these like records for driver API launch functions, although the cbid field is not used here. The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2.doc: Memory activity tracking allocation and freeing of the memory The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemory4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory4.html#structcupti__activitymemory4).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY_POOL.doc:
Memory pool activity tracking creation, destruction and trimming of the memory pool.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPool3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemoryPool3.html#structcupti__activitymemorypool3).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE.doc:
Activity record for graph-level information.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityGraphTrace2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGraphTrace2.html#structcupti__activitygraphtrace2).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_JIT.doc:
JIT (Just-in-time) operation tracking.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityJit2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityJit2.html#structcupti__activityjit2).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE.doc:
This activity can not be directly enabled or disabled.

It is enabled when [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`] is enabled and device graph trace is enabled through API [cuptiActivityEnableDeviceGraph()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga21718968b8e42071354e703eda63a000). The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityDeviceGraphTrace](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDeviceGraphTrace.html#structcupti__activitydevicegraphtrace).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEM_DECOMPRESS.doc:
Tracing batches of copies that are to be decompressed.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityMemDecompress](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemDecompress.html#structcupti__activitymemdecompress).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE.doc:
Tracing new overheads introduced on some hardware due when confidential computing is enabled.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityConfidentialComputeRotation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityConfidentialComputeRotation.html#structcupti__activityconfidentialcomputerotation).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_HOST_NODE.doc:
Tracing of host execution nodes of the CUDA graph, i.e.

nodes of type CU_GRAPH_NODE_TYPE_HOST. The corresponding activity record structure is CUpti_ActivityGraphHostNode.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_S.doc:
An activity denoting the switching of Compute Engine contexts in/out of the GPU.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch.html#structcupti__activitycomputeenginectxswitch).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_HOST_LAUNCH.doc:
An activity kind denoting the launch of a host function through cu(da)LaunchHostFunc API.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityHostLaunch](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityHostLaunch.html#structcupti__activityhostlaunch).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT.doc:
An activity kind denoting the allocation of a green context.

The corresponding activity record structure is [CUpti_ActivityGreenContext2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGreenContext2.html#structcupti__activitygreencontext2).

CUpti_ActivityLaunchType.doc: The type of the CUDA kernel launch.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_TYPE_REGULAR.doc: The kernel was launched via a regular kernel call.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_TYPE_COOPERATIVE_S.doc: The kernel was launched via API cudaLaunchCooperativeKernel() or cuLaunchCooperativeKernel().

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_TYPE_COOPERATIVE_M.doc: The kernel was launched via API cudaLaunchCooperativeKernelMultiDevice() or cuLaunchCooperativeKernelMultiDevice().

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_LAUNCH_TYPE_CBL_COMMANDLI.doc: The kernel was launched as a CBL commandlist.

CUpti_ActivityMarkerDataFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace detailed information for a marker.

User must enable [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`] as well to get records for marker data. These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`].

MARKER_DATA_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`].

MARKER_DATA_FIELD_FLAGS.doc: CUpti_ActivityFlag flags; Flags associated with the marker.

MARKER_DATA_FIELD_PAYLOAD_KIND.doc: CUpti_MetricValueKind payloadKind; Defines the payload format for the value associated with the marker.

MARKER_DATA_FIELD_COLOR.doc: uint32_t color; The color for the marker.

MARKER_DATA_FIELD_CATEGORY.doc: uint32_t category; The category for the marker.

MARKER_DATA_FIELD_CUPTI_DOMAIN_ID.doc: uint32_t cuptiDomainId; CUPTI maintained domain id required for NVTX extended payloads.

CUpti_ActivityMarkerFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace NVTX markers/ranges.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

MARKER_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

MARKER_FIELD_FLAGS.doc: CUpti_ActivityFlag flags; Flags associated with the marker.

MARKER_FIELD_TIMESTAMP.doc: uint64_t timestamp; Timestamp for the marker (in ns).

MARKER_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; The process ID of the process where the overhead is occurring.

MARKER_FIELD_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t threadId; The thread ID of the process where the overhead is occurring.

MARKER_FIELD_NAME.doc: const char \*name; Marker name for an instantaneous or start marker.

MARKER_FIELD_DOMAIN.doc: const char \*domain; Name of the domain to which this marker belongs.

CUpti_ActivityMemDecompressFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace decompression operations.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEM_DECOMPRESS`].

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEM_DECOMPRESS`].

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_DEVICE_ID.doc: uint32_t deviceId; The ID of the device where the decompression operation was recorded.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; The ID of the context where the decompression operation was recorded.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc: uint32_t streamId; The compute stream where the decompression operation was recorded.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_CHANNEL_ID.doc: uint32_t channelId; The ID of the HW channel on which the decompression operation was recorded.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_CHANNEL_TYPE.doc: CUpti_ChannelType channelType; The type of the channel on which the decompression operation was recorded.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this decompression operation.

Matches the correlation ID in the CUDA driver/runtime API activity record that launched it.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_NUMBER_OF_OPERATION.doc: uint32_t numberOfOperations; The number of decompression operations in this batch.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_SOURCE_BYTES.doc: uint64_t sourceBytes; The total number of bytes to be read and decompressed in the batch operation.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; Start timestamp of the decompression operation, in nanoseconds.

MEM_DECOMPRESS_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; End timestamp of the decompression operation, in nanoseconds.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpy2FieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace peer-to-peer memory copies.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`].

MEMCPY2_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`].

MEMCPY2_FIELD_COPY_KIND.doc:
uint8_t copyKind; Type of memory copy.

ALways CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMCPY_KIND_P2P.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

MEMCPY2_FIELD_SRC_KIND.doc:
uint8_t srcKind; Kind of source memory used in the copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

MEMCPY2_FIELD_DST_KIND.doc:
uint8_t dstKind; Kind of destination memory used in the copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

MEMCPY2_FIELD_FLAGS.doc:
uint8_t flags; Flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

MEMCPY2_FIELD_BYTES.doc: uint64_t bytes; Number of bytes transferred during the memory copy.

MEMCPY2_FIELD_START.doc:
uint64_t start; Start timestamp for the memory copy (in nanoseconds).

A value of 0 indicates timestamp couldn’t be collected.

MEMCPY2_FIELD_END.doc:

OPENMP_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENMP`].

OPENMP_FIELD_EVENT_KIND.doc:
CUpti_OpenMpEventKind eventKind; CUPTI OpenMP event kind (.

See also

CUpti_OpenMpEventKind).

OPENMP_FIELD_CU_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t cuThreadId; The ID of the thread where the OpenMP activity is executing.

OPENMP_FIELD_CU_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t cuProcessId; The ID of the process where the OpenMP activity is executing.

CUpti_ActivityOverheadFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace CUPTI and driver overhead information.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OVERHEAD`].

OVERHEAD_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OVERHEAD`].

OVERHEAD_FIELD_OVERHEAD_KIND.doc: CUpti_ActivityOverheadKind overheadKind; The kind of overhead, CUPTI, DRIVER, COMPILER etc.

OVERHEAD_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; The process ID of the process where the overhead is occurring.

OVERHEAD_FIELD_THREAD_ID.doc: uint64_t threadId; The thread ID of the process where the overhead is occurring.

OVERHEAD_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; The start timestamp for the overhead, in nanoseconds.

OVERHEAD_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; The end timestamp for the overhead, in nanoseconds.

OVERHEAD_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this overhead record.

Matches the correlation ID in the CUDA driver/runtime API activity record that launched it.

OVERHEAD_FIELD_OVERHEAD_DATA.doc:
void \*overheadData; Pointer to the struct with additional details about the overhead.

Refer CUpti_ActivityOverheadKind enum and the corresponding structure to typecast and access additional overhead data. Client is responsible for freeing this memory using the free function when done.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_UNKNOWN.doc: The overhead kind is not known.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_CUPTI_RESOURCE.doc: CUPTI resource creation and destruction overhead.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_RUNTIME_TRIGGERE.doc: CUDA Runtime triggered module loading overhead.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_COMMAND_BUFFER_F.doc:
Overhead due to lack of command buffer space.

Refer [CUpti_ActivityOverheadCommandBufferFullData](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOverheadCommandBufferFullData.html#structcupti__activityoverheadcommandbufferfulldata) for more details.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_ACTIVITY_BUFFER_.doc: Overhead due to activity buffer request.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_UVM_ACTIVITY_INI.doc: Overhead due to UVM activity initialization.

CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingPeriod.doc:
Sampling period for PC sampling method.

Sampling period can be set using [cuptiActivityConfigurePCSampling](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga115305aadc838df99d88283fc64c4317).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_PERIOD_INVALI.doc: The PC sampling period is not set.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_PERIOD_MIN.doc: Minimum sampling period available on the device.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_PERIOD_MAX.doc: Maximum sampling period available on the device.

CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingStallReason.doc: The stall reason for PC sampling activity.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_NONE.doc: No stall, instruction is selected for issue.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_INST_FE.doc: Warp is blocked because next instruction is not yet available, because of instruction cache miss, or because of branching effects.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_EXEC_DE.doc: Instruction is waiting on an arithmetic dependency.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_MEMORY_.doc: Warp is blocked because it is waiting for a memory access to complete.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_TEXTURE.doc: Texture sub-system is fully utilized or has too many outstanding requests.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_SYNC.doc: Warp is blocked as it is waiting at __syncthreads() or at memory barrier.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_CONSTAN.doc: Warp is blocked waiting for **constant** memory and immediate memory access to complete.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_PIPE_BU.doc: Compute operation cannot be performed due to the required resources not being available.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_MEMORY_.doc: Warp is blocked because there are too many pending memory operations.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PC_SAMPLING_STALL_NOT_SEL.doc: Warp was ready to issue, but some other warp issued instead.

CUpti_ActivityPcieFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityPcie](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPcie.html#structcupti__activitypcie).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityPcie](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPcie.html#structcupti__activitypcie) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

PCIE_FIELD_KIND.doc: CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of activity record: [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PCIE`].

PCIE_FIELD_TYPE.doc: CUpti_PcieDeviceType type; Type of device in topology, CUpti_PcieDeviceType.

PCIE_FIELD_ID.doc:
union id; A unique identifier for GPU or Bridge in Topology.

CUdevice devId if type is [`CUpti_PcieDeviceType::CUPTI_PCIE_DEVICE_TYPE_GPU`] uint32_t bridgeId if type is [`CUpti_PcieDeviceType::CUPTI_PCIE_DEVICE_TYPE_BRIDGE`].

PCIE_FIELD_DOMAIN.doc: uint32_t domain; Domain for the GPU or Bridge, required to identify which PCIE bus it belongs to in multiple NUMA systems.

PCIE_FIELD_PCIE_GENERATION.doc: uint16_t pcieGeneration; PCIE Generation of GPU or Bridge.

PCIE_FIELD_LINK_RATE.doc: uint16_t linkRate; Link rate of the GPU or bridge in gigatransfers per second (GT/s).

PCIE_FIELD_LINK_WIDTH.doc: uint16_t linkWidth; Link width of the GPU or bridge.

PCIE_FIELD_UPSTREAM_BUS.doc:
uint16_t upstreamBus; Upstream bus ID for the GPU or PCI bridge.

Required to identify which bus it is connected to in the topology.

PCIE_FIELD_ATTR.doc:
union attr; Attributes for more information about GPU (gpuAttr) or PCI Bridge (bridgeAttr).

[CUpti_ActivityPcieGpuAttr](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPcieGpuAttr.html#structcupti__activitypciegpuattr) gpuAttr if type is [`CUpti_PcieDeviceType::CUPTI_PCIE_DEVICE_TYPE_GPU`] [CUpti_ActivityPcieBridgeAttr](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPcieBridgeAttr.html#structcupti__activitypciebridgeattr) bridgeAttr if type is [`CUpti_PcieDeviceType::CUPTI_PCIE_DEVICE_TYPE_BRIDGE`] The size of this field is determined by the largest structure among the possible types it can hold.

CUpti_ActivityPreemptionKind.doc: The kind of a preemption activity.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_PREEMPTION_KIND_UNKNOWN.doc: The preemption kind is not known.

CUpti_ActivityStreamFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace CUDA Stream operations.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_STREAM`].

STREAM_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_STREAM`].

STREAM_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; The ID of the context where the stream was created.

STREAM_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc: uint32_t streamId; A unique stream ID to identify the stream.

STREAM_FIELD_PRIORITY.doc: int32_t priority; The clamped priority for the stream.

STREAM_FIELD_FLAG.doc: CUpti_ActivityStreamFlag flag; Flags associated with the stream.

STREAM_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc: uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this CUDA Stream operation.

CUpti_ActivityStreamFlag.doc:
stream type.

The types of stream to be used with [CUpti_ActivityStream](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityStream.html#structcupti__activitystream).

CUpti_ActivitySynchronizationFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields to trace various CUDA synchronization APIs.

These field IDs are used to reference specific fields when dynamically selecting or parsing activity records of [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SYNCHRONIZATION`].

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_KIND.doc:
CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of this activity record.

Always [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SYNCHRONIZATION`].

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_TYPE.doc: CUpti_ActivitySynchronizationType type; The type of synchronization operation.

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; The start timestamp for the synchronization operation (in nanoseconds).

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t start; The start timestamp for the synchronization operation (in nanoseconds).

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_CORRELATION_ID.doc:
uint64_t correlationId; Correlation ID assigned to this synchronization operation.

Matches the correlation ID in the CUDA driver/runtime API activity record that launched it.

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_CONTEXT_ID.doc: uint32_t contextId; CUDA context where the operation is occurring.

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc:
uint32_t streamId; The compute stream where the synchronization operation is occurring.

CUPTI_SYNCHRONIZATION_INVALID_VALUE indicates that the field is not applicable for this record.

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_CUDA_EVENT_ID.doc:
uint64_t cudaEventId; The CUDA event ID for which the synchronization operation is called.

CUPTI_SYNCHRONIZATION_INVALID_VALUE indicates that the field is not applicable for this record.

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_CUDA_EVENT_SYNC_ID.doc:
uint64_t cudaEventSyncId; A unique ID to associate event synchronization records with the latest CUDA Event record.

Similar field is added in CUpti_ActivityCudaEventFieldIds to associate synchronization record to the CUDA Event record.

The same CUDA event can be used multiple times, so the event id will not be unique to correlate the synchronization record with the latest CUDA Event record. This field will be unique and can be used to do the required correlation.

A CUPTI_SYNCHRONIZATION_INVALID_VALUE value indicates that the field is not applicable for this record. Valid only for synchronization records related to CUDA Events.

SYNCHRONIZATION_FIELD_RETURN_VALUE.doc:
uint32_t returnValue; The return value for the synchronization operation.

Use cuptiActivityEnableAllSyncRecords API to enable/disable collection of synchronization records with return value being non-zero. This will be a CUresult value.

CUpti_ActivitySynchronizationType.doc:
Synchronization type.

The types of synchronization to be used with [CUpti_ActivitySynchronization2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySynchronization2.html#structcupti__activitysynchronization2).

CUpti_ActivityThreadIdType.doc:
Thread-Id types.

CUPTI uses different methods to obtain the thread-id depending on the support and the underlying platform. This enum documents these methods for each type. APIs [cuptiSetThreadIdType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga1821f090b841d60643ee37d977d9c64a) and [cuptiGetThreadIdType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gabc957f426b741e46d6e9a99a43a974b5) can be used to set and get the thread-id type.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_THREAD_ID_TYPE_DEFAULT.doc: Default type Windows uses API GetCurrentThreadId() Linux/Mac/Android/QNX use POSIX pthread API pthread_self().

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_THREAD_ID_TYPE_SYSTEM.doc:
This type is based on the system API available on the underlying platform and thread-id obtained is supposed to be unique for the process lifetime.

Windows uses API GetCurrentThreadId() Linux uses syscall SYS_gettid Mac uses syscall SYS_thread_selfid Android/QNX use gettid().

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_THREAD_ID_TYPE_SIZE.doc: Add new enums before this field.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryAccessType.doc:
Memory access type for unified memory page faults.

This is valid for [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782a49ecdbc6d0c9b52829c8bc276932b7bf) and [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782a94faffc246c392748ab7f0de9a858b22).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_ACCESS_TYP.doc: The unified memory access type is not known.
The page fault was triggered by read memory instruction.
The page fault was triggered by write memory instruction.
The page fault was triggered by atomic memory instruction.
The page fault was triggered by memory prefetch operation.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind.doc:
Kind of the Unified Memory counter.

Many activities are associated with Unified Memory mechanism; among them are transfers from host to device, device to host, page fault at host side.

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KI.doc: The unified memory counter kind is not known.
Number of bytes transferred from host to device.
Number of bytes transferred from device to host.
Number of CPU page faults, this is only supported on 64 bit Linux and Mac platforms.
Number of GPU page faults, this is only supported on devices with compute capability 6.0 and higher and 64 bit Linux platforms.

Thrashing occurs when data is frequently accessed by multiple processors and has to be constantly migrated around to achieve data locality.

In this case the overhead of migration may exceed the benefits of locality. This is only supported on 64 bit Linux platforms.

Throttling is a prevention technique used by the driver to avoid further thrashing.

Here, the driver doesn’t service the fault for one of the contending processors for a specific period of time, so that the other processor can run at full-speed. This is only supported on 64 bit Linux platforms.

In case throttling does not help, the driver tries to pin the memory to a processor for a specific period of time.

One of the contending processors will have slow access to the memory, while the other will have fast access. This is only supported on 64 bit Linux platforms.

Number of bytes transferred from one device to another device.

This is only supported on 64 bit Linux platforms.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterScope.doc: Scope of the unified memory counter (deprecated in CUDA 7.0).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_SC.doc: The unified memory counter scope is not known.
Collect unified memory counter for single process on one device.
Collect unified memory counter for single process across all devices.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryMigrationCaus.doc:
Migration cause of the Unified Memory counter.

This is valid for [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782a7c4755228387e83351ae02b5ea5157f1) and [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782aef4bdc9da8f158bf337bdf2aedd8d780) and [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOD](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782a4fe8185509ddecb727197de672cb6e2b).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_MIGRATION_.doc: The unified memory migration cause is not known.

The unified memory migrated due to an explicit call from the user e.g.

cudaMemPrefetchAsync.

The unified memory migrated to guarantee data coherence e.g.

CPU/GPU faults on Pascal+ and kernel launch on pre-Pascal GPUs.
The unified memory was speculatively migrated by the UVM driver before being accessed by the destination processor to improve performance.
The unified memory migrated to the CPU because it was evicted to make room for another block of memory on the GPU.

The unified memory migrated to another processor because of access counter notifications.

Only frequently accessed pages are migrated between CPU and GPU, or between peer GPUs.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryRemoteMapCaus.doc:
Remote memory map cause of the Unified Memory counter.

This is valid for [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782ad6e6079c49b8024aab5afd22c3ec1706).

CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_REMOTE_MAP.doc: The cause of mapping to remote memory was unknown.
Mapping to remote memory was added to maintain data coherence.
Mapping to remote memory was added to prevent further thrashing.
Mapping to remote memory was added to enforce the hints specified by the programmer or by performance heuristics of the UVM driver.
Mapping to remote memory was added because there is no more memory available on the processor and eviction was not possible.
Mapping to remote memory was added after the memory was evicted to make room for another block of memory on the GPU.

CUpti_ActivityUvmCounterFieldIds.doc:
Enum identifiers for fields in [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3.html#structcupti__activityunifiedmemorycounter3).

Each enum value corresponds to a field in [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3.html#structcupti__activityunifiedmemorycounter3) and describes the data type and purpose of that field.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_KIND.doc: CUpti_ActivityKind kind; Kind of activity record: [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`].

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_COUNTER_KIND.doc: CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind counterKind; The Unified Memory counter kind.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_VALUE.doc: uint64_t value; Value of the counter.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_START.doc: uint64_t start; Start timestamp of the counter (in ns).

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_END.doc: uint64_t end; End timestamp of the counter (in ns).

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_ADDRESS.doc: uint64_t address; Virtual base address of the page/s being transferred.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_SRC_ID.doc: uint32_t srcId; ID of the source CPU/device.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_DST_ID.doc: uint32_t dstId; ID of the destination CPU/device.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_STREAM_ID.doc: uint32_t streamId; ID of the stream causing the transfer.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_PROCESS_ID.doc: uint32_t processId; ID of the process to which this record belongs.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_FLAGS.doc: uint32_t flags; Flags associated with this record.

UVM_COUNTER_FIELD_PROCESSORS.doc: uint64_t processors[5]; Bitmask of devices involved in the operation.

CUPTI_CHANNEL_TYPE_COMPUTE.doc: Channel is used for standard work launch and tracking.

CUPTI_CHANNEL_TYPE_ASYNC_MEMCPY.doc: Channel is used by an asynchronous copy engine For confidential compute configurations, work launch and completion are done using the copy engines.

CUPTI_CHANNEL_TYPE_DECOMP.doc: Channel is used for memory decompression operations.

CUpti_ComputeEngineCtxSwitchOperationTyp.doc: The operation type of CUDA context switch event records.

CUPTI_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_OPERATIO.doc: The start of the CUDA context switch operation.
The end of the CUDA context switch operation.

CUPTI_CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE_KEY_ROTATION_.doc: This channel has been blocked from accepting new CUDA work so a key rotation can be done.

This channel remains blocked and all queued CUDA work has completed.

Other clients or channels may cause delays in starting the key rotation.
Key rotations have completed and this channel is unblocked.

CUpti_ContextCigMode.doc:
CIG (CUDA in Graphics) Modes.

Describes the CIG modes associated with the CUDA context.

CUpti_DevType.doc: The device type for device connected to NVLink.

CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU.doc: The device type is NVLink processing unit in CPU.

CUpti_DeviceGraphLaunchMode.doc: The launch mode for device graph execution.

CUpti_DeviceVirtualizationMode.doc: This indicates the virtualization mode in which CUDA device is running.

CUPTI_DEVICE_VIRTUALIZATION_MODE_NONE.doc:
No virtualization mode is associated with the device i.e.

it’s a baremetal GPU.

CUPTI_DEVICE_VIRTUALIZATION_MODE_PASS_TH.doc:
The device is associated with the pass-through GPU.

In this mode, an entire physical GPU is directly assigned to one virtual machine (VM).

CUPTI_DEVICE_VIRTUALIZATION_MODE_VIRTUAL.doc:
The device is associated with the virtual GPU (vGPU).

In this mode multiple virtual machines (VMs) have simultaneous, direct access to a single physical GPU.

CUpti_EnvironmentClocksThrottleReason.doc:
Reasons for clock throttling.

The possible reasons that a clock can be throttled. There can be more than one reason that a clock is being throttled so these types can be combined by bitwise OR. These are used in the clocksThrottleReason field in the Environment Activity Record.

CUPTI_CLOCKS_THROTTLE_REASON_GPU_IDLE.doc: Nothing is running on the GPU and the clocks are dropping to idle state.

CUPTI_CLOCKS_THROTTLE_REASON_USER_DEFINE.doc: The GPU clocks are limited by a user specified limit.

CUPTI_CLOCKS_THROTTLE_REASON_SW_POWER_CA.doc: A software power scaling algorithm is reducing the clocks below requested clocks.

CUPTI_CLOCKS_THROTTLE_REASON_HW_SLOWDOWN.doc:
Hardware slowdown to reduce the clock by a factor of two or more is engaged.

This is an indicator of one of the following: 1) Temperature is too high, 2) External power brake assertion is being triggered (e.g. by the system power supply), 3) Change in power state.

CUPTI_CLOCKS_THROTTLE_REASON_UNKNOWN.doc: Some unspecified factor is reducing the clocks.

CUPTI_CLOCKS_THROTTLE_REASON_UNSUPPORTED.doc: Throttle reason is not supported for this GPU.

CUpti_ExternalCorrelationKind.doc:
The kind of external APIs supported for correlation.

Custom correlation kinds are reserved for usage in external tools.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityExternalCorrelation](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityExternalCorrelation.html#structcupti__activityexternalcorrelation).

CUPTI_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_KIND_UNKNOWN.doc: The external API is unknown to CUPTI.

CUPTI_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_KIND_SIZE.doc: Add new kinds before this line.

CUpti_FuncExecutionModel.doc:
The execution model of a kernel function.

This should be used to set executionModel field in kernel records.

CUpti_FuncShmemLimitConfig.doc: The shared memory limit per block config for a kernel This should be used to set ‘cudaOccFuncShmemConfig’ field in occupancy calculator API.

CUPTI_FUNC_SHMEM_LIMIT_DEFAULT.doc: The shared memory limit config is default.

CUPTI_FUNC_SHMEM_LIMIT_OPTIN.doc: User has opted for a higher dynamic shared memory limit using function attribute ‘cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize’ for runtime API or CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES for driver API.

CUpti_LinkFlag.doc:
Link flags.

Describes link properties, to be used with [CUpti_ActivityNvLink](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityNvLink.html#structcupti__activitynvlink).

CUPTI_LINK_FLAG_PEER_ACCESS.doc: Is peer to peer access supported by this link.

CUPTI_LINK_FLAG_SYSMEM_ACCESS.doc: Is system memory access supported by this link.

CUPTI_LINK_FLAG_PEER_ATOMICS.doc: Is peer atomic access supported by this link.

CUPTI_LINK_FLAG_SYSMEM_ATOMICS.doc: Is system memory atomic access supported by this link.

CUPTI_NVTX_EXT_PAYLOAD_TYPE_UNKNOWN.doc: The payload type is not known.

CUPTI_NVTX_EXT_PAYLOAD_TYPE_SCHEMA.doc: The payload type is a schema.

CUPTI_NVTX_EXT_PAYLOAD_TYPE_ENUM.doc: The payload type is an enum.

CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind.doc: The OpenAcc parent construct kind for OpenAcc activity records.

CUpti_OpenAccEventKind.doc:
The OpenAcc event kind for OpenAcc activity records.

See also

CUpti_ActivityKindOpenAcc.

CUpti_PcieDeviceType.doc: Field to differentiate whether PCIE Activity record is of a GPU or a PCI Bridge.

CUpti_PcieGen.doc:
PCIE Generation.

Enumeration of PCIE Generation for pcie activity attribute pcieGeneration.

cuptiActivityConfigurePCSampling.doc:
Set PC sampling configuration.

For Pascal and older GPU architectures this API must be called before enabling activity kind [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`]. There is no such requirement for Volta and newer GPU architectures.

For Volta and newer GPU architectures if this API is called in the middle of execution, PC sampling configuration will be updated for subsequent kernel launches.

Starting with CUDA 13.0, this function is unsupported and should not be used. It always returns the error code [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_LEGACY_PROFILER_NOT_SUPPORTED`].

ctx.doc: The context.

config.doc: A pointer to [CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingConfig](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPCSamplingConfig.html#structcupti__activitypcsamplingconfig) structure containing PC sampling configuration.

CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_OPERATION.doc: if this api is called while some valid event collection method is set.

CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER.doc: if `config` is NULL or any parameter in the `config` structures is not a valid value.

CUPTI_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: Indicates that the system/device does not support the unified memory counters.

cuptiActivityConfigureUnifiedMemoryCount.doc:
Set Unified Memory Counter configuration.

Set the configuration before enabling the corresponding activity kind [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`]. The API should be called after CUDA driver initialization.

config.doc: A pointer to [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterConfig](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterConfig.html#structcupti__activityunifiedmemorycounterconfig) structures containing Unified Memory counter configuration.

count.doc: Number of Unified Memory counter configuration structures.

CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER.doc: if `config` is NULL or any parameter in the `config` structures is not a valid value.

CUPTI_ERROR_UM_PROFILING_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: One potential reason is that platform (OS/arch) does not support the unified memory counters.

CUPTI_ERROR_UM_PROFILING_NOT_SUPPORTED_O.doc: Indicates that the device does not support the unified memory counters.
Indicates that multi-GPU configuration without P2P support between any pair of devices does not support the unified memory counters.

cuptiActivityDisable.doc:
Disable collection of a specific kind of activity record.

Disable collection of a specific kind of activity record. Multiple kinds can be disabled by calling this function multiple times. By default all activity kinds are disabled for collection.

CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_KIND.doc: if the activity kind is not supported.

cuptiActivityDisableContext.doc:
Disable collection of a specific kind of activity record for a context.

Disable collection of a specific kind of activity record for a context. This setting done by this API will supersede the global settings for activity records. Multiple kinds can be enabled by calling this function multiple times.

context.doc: The context for which activity is to be disabled.

kind.doc: The kind of activity record to stop collecting.

CUPTI_ERROR_INVALID_KIND.doc: if the activity kind is not supported.

cuptiActivityDisable_v2.doc:

Disable collection of a specific kind of activity record. Multiple kinds can be disabled by calling this function multiple times. By default all activity kinds are disabled for collection.

pActivityConfig.doc: The activity config. It can be NULL.
