numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors assigned to the green context Invalid if the field ‘isGreenContext’ is 0.

cigMode.doc: This field indicates the CIG mode.

processId.doc: The ID of the process associated with the context.

CUpti_ActivityContext3.doc:
The activity record for a context.

This activity record represents information about a context ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`].

contextId.doc: The context ID.

deviceId.doc: The device ID.

computeApiKind.doc:
The compute API kind.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityComputeApiKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaf46dcec421da358ab4e9edad76774179).

nullStreamId.doc: The ID for the NULL stream in this context.

parentContextId.doc:
The ID of the parent context.

It would be 0 if context does not have parent.

isGreenContext.doc: This field indicates whether the context is a green context.

numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors assigned to the green context Invalid if the field ‘isGreenContext’ is 0.

cigMode.doc: This field indicates the CIG mode.

CUpti_ActivityPCSampling2.doc:
The activity record for PC sampling.

(deprecated in CUDA 9.0)

This activity records information obtained by sampling PC ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`]). PC sampling activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityPCSampling3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPCSampling3.html#structcupti__activitypcsampling3) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`].

flags.doc: The properties of this instruction.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the instruction.

latencySamples.doc:
Number of times the PC was sampled with the stallReason in the record.

These samples indicate that no instruction was issued in that cycle from the warp scheduler from where the warp was sampled. Field is valid for devices with compute capability 6.0 and higher.

samples.doc:
Number of times the PC was sampled with the stallReason in the record.

The same PC can be sampled with different stall reasons. The count includes latencySamples.

stallReason.doc:
Current stall reason.

Includes one of the reasons from [CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingStallReason](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga57bafb9baafeae0880dae6eaa1a8e12d).

pHostObject.doc: [in] The profiler host object created via cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

pDevicePartitionInfo.doc: [in] Buffer containing the device partition information obtained from the target side using cuptiRangeProfilerGetDevicePartitionInfo. This encodes the SM resource allocation for the Green Context being profiled.

devicePartitionInfoSize.doc: [in] Size of the device partition info buffer in bytes.

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingGetStallReasonsParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

ctx.doc: [w] CUcontext.

CUpti_ActivityPcieBridgeAttr.doc: Attributes for more information about PCI Bridge (bridgeAttr).

secondaryBus.doc: The downstream bus number, used to search downstream devices/bridges connected to this bridge.

deviceId.doc: Device ID of the bridge.

CUpti_ActivityEvent.doc:
The activity record for a CUPTI event.

This activity record represents a CUPTI event value ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT`]). This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profile frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect event data may choose to use this type to store the collected event data.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT`].

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the event.

Use of this ID is user-defined, but typically this ID value will equal the correlation ID of the kernel for which the event was gathered.

size.doc:
[w] Size of configuration structure.

CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

cubinCrc.doc: [r] Computed CRC will be stored in it.

CUpti_ActivityContext2.doc:
The activity record for a context.

This activity record represents information about a context ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`]). Context activity is now reported using [CUpti_ActivityContext3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityContext3.html#structcupti__activitycontext3) record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`].

contextId.doc: The context ID.

deviceId.doc: The device ID.

computeApiKind.doc:
The compute API kind.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityComputeApiKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaf46dcec421da358ab4e9edad76774179).

nullStreamId.doc: The ID for the NULL stream in this context.

parentContextId.doc:
The ID of the parent context.

It would be 0 if context does not have parent.

isGreenContext.doc: This field indicates whether the context is a green context.

numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors assigned to the green context Invalid if the field ‘isGreenContext’ is 0.

CUpti_SynchronizeData.doc:
Data passed into a synchronize callback function.

Data passed into a synchronize callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_SYNCHRONIZE`]. The callback data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data.

context.doc: The context of the stream being synchronized.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

CUpti_ActivityMarkerData.doc:
The activity record providing detailed information for a marker.

User must enable [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`] as well to get records for marker data. The marker data contains color, payload, and category. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`]).

Structure deprecated in CUDA 13.1: Refer to [CUpti_ActivityMarkerData2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMarkerData2.html#structcupti__activitymarkerdata2) for the latest structure.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the marker.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

payloadKind.doc: Defines the payload format for the value associated with the marker.

CUpti_ActivityInstructionExecution.doc:
The activity record for source-level instruction execution.

This activity records result for source level instruction execution. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTRUCTION_EXECUTION`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTRUCTION_EXECUTION`].

flags.doc: The properties of this instruction execution.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the instruction.

threadsExecuted.doc: This increments each time when this instruction is executed by number of threads that executed this instruction, regardless of predicate or condition code.

notPredOffThreadsExecuted.doc: This increments each time when this instruction is executed by number of threads that executed this instruction with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

executed.doc:
The number of times this instruction was executed per warp.

It will be incremented regardless of predicate or condition code.

CUpti_ActivityOpenMp.doc:
The base activity record for OpenMp records.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3).

kind.doc: The kind of this activity.

eventKind.doc:
CUPTI OpenMP event kind (.

See also

CUpti_OpenMpEventKind).

start.doc: CUPTI start timestamp.

end.doc: CUPTI end timestamp.

cuProcessId.doc: The ID of the process where the OpenMP activity is executing.

cuThreadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the OpenMP activity is executing.

CUpti_ActivityPCSampling.doc:
The activity record for PC sampling.

(deprecated in CUDA 8.0)

This activity records information obtained by sampling PC ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`]). PC sampling activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityPCSampling2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPCSampling2.html#structcupti__activitypcsampling2) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`].

flags.doc: The properties of this instruction.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the instruction.

samples.doc:
Number of times the PC was sampled with the stallReason in the record.

The same PC can be sampled with different stall reasons.

stallReason.doc:
Current stall reason.

Includes one of the reasons from [CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingStallReason](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga57bafb9baafeae0880dae6eaa1a8e12d).

CUpti_ActivityMemcpyPtoP2.doc:
The activity record for peer-to-peer memory copies.

(deprecated in CUDA 11.1)

This activity record represents a peer-to-peer memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

srcDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where memory is being copied from.

srcContextId.doc: The ID of the context owning the memory being copied from.

dstDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where memory is being copied to.

dstContextId.doc: The ID of the context owning the memory being copied to.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory copy.

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that executed the memcpy through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if memcpy is not done using graph launch.

pHostObject.doc: [in] reference to the profiler host object allocated by CUPTI in cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

configImageSize.doc: [in] Number of bytes allocated for pBuffer.

CUpti_ActivityMemory3.doc:
The activity record for memory.

This activity record represents a memory allocation and free operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2`]). This activity record provides separate records for memory allocation and memory release operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory operation.

Note: This activity record is an upgrade over [CUpti_ActivityMemory2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory2.html#structcupti__activitymemory2) enabled using the kind [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ggaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3afee93ef030088d7a992a1abd6d6e53b0). [CUpti_ActivityMemory](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory.html#structcupti__activitymemory) provides a single record for the memory allocation and memory release operations.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2`].

memoryOperationType.doc: The memory operation requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga6404b89cfbbd60e04204244d230b15c4).

memoryKind.doc: The memory kind requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory operation.

Each memory operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory operation.

address.doc:
The virtual address of the allocation.

The base address of the memory pool.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes of memory allocated.

timestamp.doc: The start timestamp for the memory operation, in ns.

PC.doc: The program counter of the memory operation.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory operation is taking place.

contextId.doc:
The ID of the context.

If context is NULL, `contextId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_CONTEXT_ID.

streamId.doc:
The ID of the stream.

If memory operation is not async, `streamId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_STREAM_ID.

name.doc:
Variable name.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same symbol, and so should not be modified.

isAsync.doc: `isAsync` is set if memory operation happens through async memory APIs.

memoryPoolType.doc: The type of the memory pool, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

releaseThreshold.doc:
The release threshold of the memory pool in bytes.

`releaseThreshold` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

pool.doc:
The size of memory pool in bytes and the processId of the memory pools `size` is valid if `memoryPoolType` is [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

`processId` is valid if `memoryPoolType` is [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_IMPORTED`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

utilizedSize.doc:
The utilized size of the memory pool.

`utilizedSize` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

memoryPoolConfig.doc: The memory pool configuration used for the memory operations.

CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess.doc:
The activity record for source-level global access.

(deprecated)

This activity records the locations of the global accesses in the source ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GLOBAL_ACCESS`]). Global access activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGlobalAccess3.html#structcupti__activityglobalaccess3) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GLOBAL_ACCESS`].

flags.doc: The properties of this global access.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the access.

executed.doc:
The number of times this instruction was executed per warp.

It will be incremented when at least one of thread among warp is active with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

threadsExecuted.doc: This increments each time when this instruction is executed by number of threads that executed this instruction with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

l2_transactions.doc: The total number of 32 bytes transactions to L2 cache generated by this access.

CUpti_ActivityObjectKindId.doc:
Identifiers for object kinds as specified by CUpti_ActivityObjectKind.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityObjectKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9b6136c1123883722ded735eb52cf270).

pt.doc:
A process object requires that we identify the process ID.

A thread object requires that we identify both the process and thread ID.

dcs.doc:
A device object requires that we identify the device ID.

A context object requires that we identify both the device and context ID. A stream object requires that we identify device, context, and stream ID.

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingStartParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

ctx.doc: [w] CUcontext.

CUpti_ActivityOpenAcc.doc:
The base activity record for OpenAcc records.

The OpenACC activity API part uses a [CUpti_ActivityOpenAcc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAcc.html#structcupti__activityopenacc) as a generic representation for any OpenACC activity. The ‘kind’ field is used to determine the specific activity kind, and from that the [CUpti_ActivityOpenAcc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAcc.html#structcupti__activityopenacc) object can be cast to the specific OpenACC activity record type appropriate for that kind.

Note that all OpenACC activity record types are padded and aligned to ensure that each member of the record is naturally aligned.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3).

kind.doc: The kind of this activity.

eventKind.doc:
CUPTI OpenACC event kind (.

See also

[CUpti_OpenAccEventKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga0e638b0b6a210164345ab159bcba6717)).

parentConstruct.doc:
CUPTI OpenACC parent construct kind (.

Note that for applications using PGI OpenACC runtime < 16.1, this will always be [`CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind::CUPTI_OPENACC_CONSTRUCT_KIND_UNKNOWN`].

See also

[CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaad1f871f3bfe3f626520561cc767881e)).

implicit.doc: 1 for any implicit event, such as an implicit wait at a synchronous data construct 0 otherwise.

async.doc: Value of [async()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAcc.html#structcupti__activityopenacc_1a7f2f1ba8677db32397be3d1bcbf69d8d) clause of the corresponding directive.

lineNo.doc:
The line number of the directive or program construct or the starting line number of the OpenACC construct corresponding to the event.

A zero value means the line number is not known.

endLineNo.doc:
For an OpenACC construct, this contains the line number of the end of the construct.

A zero value means the line number is not known.

funcLineNo.doc:
The line number of the first line of the function named in funcName.

A zero value means the line number is not known.

funcEndLineNo.doc:
The last line number of the function named in funcName.

A zero value means the line number is not known.

start.doc: CUPTI start timestamp.

end.doc: CUPTI end timestamp.

cuDeviceId.doc: CUDA device id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuContextId.doc: CUDA context id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuStreamId.doc: CUDA stream id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuProcessId.doc: The ID of the process where the OpenACC activity is executing.

cuThreadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the OpenACC activity is executing.

externalId.doc:
The OpenACC correlation ID.

Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia. If not 0, it uniquely identifies this record. It is identical to the externalId in the preceding external correlation record of type [`CUpti_ExternalCorrelationKind::CUPTI_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_KIND_OPENACC`].

CUpti_ActivityKernel6.doc:
The activity record for kernel.

(deprecated in CUDA 11.6)

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]) but is no longer generated by CUPTI. Kernel activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityKernel9](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel9.html#structcupti__activitykernel9) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

requested.doc:
The cache configuration requested by the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

executed.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

cacheConfig.doc: For devices with compute capability 7.5+ cacheConfig values are not updated in case field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:
The shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUsharedconfig enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

partitionedGlobalCacheRequested.doc:
The partitioned global caching requested for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2.

partitionedGlobalCacheExecuted.doc:
The partitioned global caching executed for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2. Partitioned global caching can be automatically disabled if the occupancy requirement of the launch cannot support caching.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

completed.doc:
The completed timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

It represents the completion of all it’s child kernels and the kernel itself. A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the completion time is unknown.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

queued.doc:
The timestamp when the kernel is queued up in the command buffer, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

Command buffer is a buffer written by CUDA driver to send commands like kernel launch, memory copy etc to the GPU. All launches of CUDA kernels are asynchronous with respect to the host, the host requests the launch by writing commands into the command buffer, then returns without checking the GPU’s progress.

submitted.doc:
The timestamp when the command buffer containing the kernel launch is submitted to the GPU, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the submitted time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

launchType.doc:
The indicates if the kernel was executed via a regular launch or via a single/multi device cooperative launch.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityLaunchType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gad054e12847a4a5a0ece53d2cb6dc6d8c).

isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested.doc: This indicates if CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT was updated for the kernel launch.

sharedMemoryCarveoutRequested.doc:
Shared memory carveout value requested for the function in percentage of the total resource.

The value will be updated only if field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryExecuted.doc: Shared memory size set by the driver.

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

This field will be 0 if the kernel is not launched through graph launch APIs.

shmemLimitConfig.doc:
The shared memory limit config for the kernel.

This field shows whether user has opted for a higher per block limit of dynamic shared memory.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

This field will be 0 if the kernel is not launched through graph launch APIs.

pAccessPolicyWindow.doc:
The pointer to the access policy window.

The structure CUaccessPolicyWindow is defined in cuda.h.

CUpti_Activity.doc:
The base activity record.

The activity API uses a [CUpti_Activity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__Activity.html#structcupti__activity) as a generic representation for any activity. The ‘kind’ field is used to determine the specific activity kind, and from that the [CUpti_Activity](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__Activity.html#structcupti__activity) object can be cast to the specific activity record type appropriate for that kind.

Note that all activity record types are padded and aligned to ensure that each member of the record is naturally aligned.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3).

kind.doc: The kind of this activity.

CUpti_ActivityNvLink3.doc:
NVLink information.

This structure gives capabilities of each logical NVLink connection between two devices, gpu<->gpu or gpu<->CPU which can be used to understand the topology. NvLink information is now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityNvLink5](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityNvLink5.html#structcupti__activitynvlink5) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NVLINK`].

index.doc:
Index of the NPU.

First index will always be zero.

domainId.doc:
Domain ID of NPU.

On Linux, this can be queried using lspci.

idDev0.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 0.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

idDev1.doc:
If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 1.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

flag.doc:
Flag gives capabilities of the link.

See also

[CUpti_LinkFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga819d686d23d2a3dfed9cc1d3c4ecb162).

physicalNvLinkCount.doc: Number of physical NVLinks present between two devices.

portDev0.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 16 NVLinks connected to device 0.

If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

portDev1.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 16 NVLinks connected to device 1.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

nvswitchConnected.doc: NVSwitch is connected as an intermediate node.

CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess2.doc:
The activity record for source-level global access.

(deprecated in CUDA 9.0)

This activity records the locations of the global accesses in the source ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GLOBAL_ACCESS`]). Global access activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityGlobalAccess3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGlobalAccess3.html#structcupti__activityglobalaccess3) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GLOBAL_ACCESS`].

flags.doc: The properties of this global access.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the access.

threadsExecuted.doc: This increments each time when this instruction is executed by number of threads that executed this instruction with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

l2_transactions.doc: The total number of 32 bytes transactions to L2 cache generated by this access.

theoreticalL2Transactions.doc: The minimum number of L2 transactions possible based on the access pattern.

executed.doc:
The number of times this instruction was executed per warp.

It will be incremented when at least one of thread among warp is active with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

CUpti_ActivityMetric.doc:
The activity record for a CUPTI metric.

This activity record represents the collection of a CUPTI metric value ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC`]). This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profile frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect metric data may choose to use this type to store the collected metric data.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC`].

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the metric.

Use of this ID is user-defined, but typically this ID value will equal the correlation ID of the kernel for which the metric was gathered.

flags.doc:
The properties of this metric.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

ctx.doc: [in] Context to be used for profiling. For green context, users can convert the green context to CUDA context using cuCtxFromGreenCtx and pass the CUDA context to this API.

pRangeProfilerObject.doc: [in] Range profiler object created via cuptiRangeProfilerEnable on a Green Context.

devicePartitionInfoSize.doc: [inout] If `pDevicePartitionInfo` is NULL, then the required buffer size is returned in `devicePartitionInfoSize`. Otherwise, `devicePartitionInfoSize` should be set to the allocated buffer size of `pDevicePartitionInfo`.

pDevicePartitionInfo.doc: [inout] Buffer to store the device partition information. Set to NULL in the first call to query the required buffer size. In the second call, pass an allocated buffer of size `devicePartitionInfoSize` to receive the partition information encoding the SM resource allocation for the Green Context.

structSize.doc:
Size of the data structure.

CUPTI should set the size of the structure. It will be used by CUPTI clients to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

threadId.doc:
The thread ID that triggered the buffer completion.

This field is useful when buffers are completed per-thread. Check CUpti_ActivityAttribute [`CUpti_ActivityAttribute::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_PER_THREAD_ACTIVITY_BUFFER`] to know if per-thread activity buffers are enabled. For example: User can log which thread completed the buffer.

ppRecordLayouts.doc:
Array of record layouts present in the buffer.

This field is useful when user-defined activity records are used. Check CUpti_ActivityAttribute [`CUpti_ActivityAttribute::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_USER_DEFINED_RECORDS`] to know if user-defined activity records are enabled. For example: User can parse the buffer based on the record layouts.

numRecordLayouts.doc:
Number of different record layouts present in the buffer.

This field is useful when user-defined activity records are used. Check CUpti_ActivityAttribute [`CUpti_ActivityAttribute::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ATTR_USER_DEFINED_RECORDS`] to know if user-defined activity records are enabled. For example: User can parse the buffer based on the record layouts.

CUpti_ActivityGraphTrace.doc:
The activity record for trace of graph execution.

This activity record represents execution for a graph without giving visibility about the execution of its nodes. This is intended to reduce overheads in tracing each node. The activity kind is [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`] Graph trace activity is now reported using [CUpti_ActivityGraphTrace2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGraphTrace2.html#structcupti__activitygraphtrace2) record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`].

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the graph launch.

Each graph launch is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the graph.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the graph.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the graph.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the graph execution is occurring.

graphId.doc: The unique ID of the graph that is launched.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the graph is being launched.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the graph is being launched.

reserved.doc: This field is reserved for internal use.

CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingConfig.doc:
PC sampling configuration structure.

This structure defines the pc sampling configuration.

See function [cuptiActivityConfigurePCSampling](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga115305aadc838df99d88283fc64c4317).

size.doc:
Size of configuration structure.

CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

samplingPeriod.doc:
There are 5 level provided for sampling period.

The level internally maps to a period in terms of cycles. Same level can map to different number of cycles on different gpus. No of cycles will be chosen to minimize information loss. The period chosen will be given by samplingPeriodInCycles in [CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingRecordInfo](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityPCSamplingRecordInfo.html#structcupti__activitypcsamplingrecordinfo) for each kernel instance.

samplingPeriod2.doc:
This will override the period set by samplingPeriod.

Value 0 in samplingPeriod2 will be considered as samplingPeriod2 should not be used and samplingPeriod should be used. Valid values for samplingPeriod2 are between 5 to 31 both inclusive. This will set the sampling period to (2^samplingPeriod2) cycles.

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure.

CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

functionIndex.doc: The function’s unique symbol index in the module.

functionName.doc:
[r] The function name.

This name string might be shared across all the records including records from activity APIs representing the same function, and so it should not be modified or freed until post processing of all the records is done. Once done, it is user’s responsibility to free the memory using free() function.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

Only valid for serialized mode of pc sampling collection. For continuous mode of collection the correlationId will be set to 0.

CUpti_ResourceData.doc:
Data passed into a resource callback function.

Data passed into a resource callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_RESOURCE`]. The callback data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data.

context.doc:
For [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_CONTEXT_CREATED`] and [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_CONTEXT_DESTROY_STARTING`], the context being created or destroyed.

For [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_STREAM_CREATED`] and [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_STREAM_DESTROY_STARTING`], the context containing the stream being created or destroyed.

stream.doc: For [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_STREAM_CREATED`] and [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_STREAM_DESTROY_STARTING`], the stream being created or destroyed.

CUpti_ActivityFunction.doc:
The activity record for global/device functions.

This activity records function name and corresponding module information. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_FUNCTION`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_FUNCTION`].

id.doc: ID to uniquely identify the record.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the function is launched.

moduleId.doc: The module ID in which this global/device function is present.

functionIndex.doc: The function’s unique symbol index in the module.

name.doc:
The name of the function.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

CUpti_ActivityNvLink2.doc:
NVLink information.

(deprecated in CUDA 10.0)

This structure gives capabilities of each logical NVLink connection between two devices, gpu<->gpu or gpu<->CPU which can be used to understand the topology. NvLink information is now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityNvLink5](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityNvLink5.html#structcupti__activitynvlink5) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NVLINK`].

index.doc:
Index of the NPU.

First index will always be zero.

domainId.doc:
Domain ID of NPU.

On Linux, this can be queried using lspci.

idDev0.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 0.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

idDev1.doc:
If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 1.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

flag.doc:
Flag gives capabilities of the link.

See also

[CUpti_LinkFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga819d686d23d2a3dfed9cc1d3c4ecb162).

physicalNvLinkCount.doc: Number of physical NVLinks present between two devices.

portDev0.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 16 NVLinks connected to device 0.

If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

portDev1.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 16 NVLinks connected to device 1.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

CUpti_ActivityKernel4.doc:
The activity record for a kernel (CUDA 9.0(with sm_70 support) onwards).

(deprecated in CUDA 11.0)

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]). Kernel activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityKernel9](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel9.html#structcupti__activitykernel9) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

requested.doc:
The cache configuration requested by the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

executed.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

cacheConfig.doc: For devices with compute capability 7.5+ cacheConfig values are not updated in case field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:
The shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUsharedconfig enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

partitionedGlobalCacheRequested.doc:
The partitioned global caching requested for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2.

partitionedGlobalCacheExecuted.doc:
The partitioned global caching executed for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2. Partitioned global caching can be automatically disabled if the occupancy requirement of the launch cannot support caching.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

completed.doc:
The completed timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

It represents the completion of all it’s child kernels and the kernel itself. A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the completion time is unknown.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

queued.doc:
The timestamp when the kernel is queued up in the command buffer, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

Command buffer is a buffer written by CUDA driver to send commands like kernel launch, memory copy etc to the GPU. All launches of CUDA kernels are asynchronous with respect to the host, the host requests the launch by writing commands into the command buffer, then returns without checking the GPU’s progress.

submitted.doc:
The timestamp when the command buffer containing the kernel launch is submitted to the GPU, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the submitted time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

launchType.doc:
The indicates if the kernel was executed via a regular launch or via a single/multi device cooperative launch.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityLaunchType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gad054e12847a4a5a0ece53d2cb6dc6d8c).

isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested.doc: This indicates if CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT was updated for the kernel launch.

sharedMemoryCarveoutRequested.doc:
Shared memory carveout value requested for the function in percentage of the total resource.

The value will be updated only if field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryExecuted.doc: Shared memory size set by the driver.

CUpti_ActivityModule.doc:
The activity record for a CUDA module.

This activity record represents a CUDA module ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MODULE`]). This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profile frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect module data from the module callback may choose to use this type to store the collected module data.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MODULE`].

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the module is loaded.

pMetricNames.doc: [in] Names of the metrics to be collected.

numMetrics.doc: [in] Number of metrics to be collected.

maxNumOfRanges.doc: [in] Maximum number of ranges to be stored in the counter data image.

maxNumRangeTreeNodes.doc: [in] Maximum number of RangeTree nodes; must be >= maxNumOfRanges.

counterDataSize.doc: [out] Size of the counter data image.

passIndex.doc: [out] pass index for the replay session.

targetNestingLevel.doc: [out] target nesting level for the replay session.

isAllPassSubmitted.doc: [out] 1 if all passes are submitted to GPU for collection, 0 otherwise.

CUpti_NvtxData.doc:
Data passed into a NVTX callback function.

Data passed into a NVTX callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_NVTX`]. Unless otherwise notes, the callback data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data.

functionName.doc:
Name of the NVTX API function which issued the callback.

This string is a global constant and so may be accessed outside of the callback.

functionParams.doc:
Pointer to the arguments passed to the NVTX API call.

See generated_nvtx_meta.h for structure definitions for the parameters for each NVTX API function.

functionReturnValue.doc:
Pointer to the return value of the NVTX API call.

See nvToolsExt.h for each NVTX API function’s return value.

CUpti_ActivityPreemption.doc:
The activity record for a preemption of a CDP kernel.

This activity record represents a preemption of a CDP kernel.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PREEMPTION`].

timestamp.doc:
The timestamp of the preemption, in ns.

A value of 0 indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the preemption.

gridId.doc: The grid-id of the block that is preempted.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension of the block that is preempted.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension of the block that is preempted.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension of the block that is preempted.

pCounterDataScratchBuffer.doc: [in] the scratch buffer to be initialized.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpyPtoP4.doc:
The activity record for peer-to-peer memory copies.

This activity record represents a peer-to-peer memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

srcDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where memory is being copied from.

srcContextId.doc: The ID of the context owning the memory being copied from.

dstDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where memory is being copied to.

dstContextId.doc: The ID of the context owning the memory being copied to.

correlationId.doc:

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that executed the memcpy through graph launch.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that executed this memcpy through graph launch.

channelID.doc: The ID of the HW channel on which the memory copy is occurring.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

pHostObject.doc: [in] reference to the profiler host object allocated by CUPTI in cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

ppMetricNames.doc: [in] metric names for which config image will be generated.

size.doc:

functionName.doc: [w] Function name to which PC belongs.

lineNumber.doc: [r] Line number in the source code.

dirName.doc: [r] Path for the directory of source file.

CUpti_ActivityHostLaunch.doc:
The activity record for host launch functions.

contextId.doc: The ID of the CUDA context to which the waiting CUDA stream belongs.

correlationId.doc:

processId.doc: The ID of the process where the host function is executing.

threadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the host function is executing.

start.doc:
The start timestamp.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the start time is unknown.

end.doc:
The end timestamp.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the start time is unknown.

CUpti_ActivityNvLinkNpu.doc:
NPU identifier for NVLink connections.

This structure identifies an NPU by index and domain ID.

index.doc:
Index of the NPU.

First index will always be zero.

domainId.doc:
Domain ID of NPU.

On Linux, this can be queried using lspci.

CUpti_StateData.doc:
Data passed into a State callback function.

Data passed into a State callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_STATE`] and callback Ids belonging to CUpti_CallbackIdState. Unless otherwise noted, the callback data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data.

message.doc:
String containing more details.

It can be NULL.

notification.doc: Data passed along with the callback Ids Enum CUpti_CallbackIdState used to denote callback ids.

pHostObject.doc: [in] reference to the profiler host object allocated by CUPTI in cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

configImageSize.doc: [out] the size of config image, users need to allocate the buffer for storing.

CUpti_ActivityDevice5.doc:
The activity record for a device.

This activity record represents information about a GPU device ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`].

flags.doc:

globalMemoryBandwidth.doc: The global memory bandwidth available on the device, in kBytes/sec.

globalMemorySize.doc: The amount of global memory on the device, in bytes.

constantMemorySize.doc: The amount of constant memory on the device, in bytes.

l2CacheSize.doc: The size of the L2 cache on the device, in bytes.

numThreadsPerWarp.doc: The number of threads per warp on the device.

coreClockRate.doc: The core clock rate of the device, in kHz.

numMemcpyEngines.doc: Number of memory copy engines on the device.

numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors on the device.

maxIPC.doc: The maximum “instructions per cycle” possible on each device multiprocessor.

maxWarpsPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of warps that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxBlocksPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of blocks that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory available per multiprocessor, in bytes.

maxRegistersPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of 32-bit registers available per multiprocessor.

maxRegistersPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of registers that can be allocated to a block.

maxSharedMemoryPerBlock.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory that can be assigned to a block, in bytes.

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of threads allowed in a block.

maxBlockDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a block.

maxGridDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a grid.

computeCapabilityMajor.doc: Compute capability for the device, major number.

computeCapabilityMinor.doc: Compute capability for the device, minor number.

uuid.doc:
The device UUID.

name.doc:
The device name.

isCudaVisible.doc:
Flag to indicate whether the device is visible to CUDA.

gpuInstanceId.doc:
GPU Instance id for MIG enabled devices.

If mig mode is disabled value is set to UINT32_MAX.

computeInstanceId.doc:
Compute Instance id for MIG enabled devices.

If mig mode is disabled value is set to UINT32_MAX.

migUuid.doc:
The MIG UUID.

This value is the globally unique immutable alphanumeric identifier of the device.

isNumaNode.doc: Numa (Non-uniform memory access) information for device GPU is a NUMA node or not.

numaId.doc: Numa (Non-uniform memory access) information for device NUMA node ID of the GPU memory if GPU is not a NUMA node, it returns invalidNumaId.

pChipName.doc: [in] the chip name for which the single pass metric sets will be queried.

numOfSinglePassSets.doc: [out] number of single pass metric sets.

ppSinglePassSets.doc: [out] list of single pass metric sets.

CUpti_CallbackData.doc:
Data passed into a runtime or driver API callback function.

Data passed into a runtime or driver API callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_DRIVER_API`] or [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_RUNTIME_API`]. The callback data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data. For example, if you make a shallow copy of [CUpti_CallbackData](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__CallbackData.html#structcupti__callbackdata) within a callback, you cannot dereference `functionParams` outside of that callback to access the function parameters. `functionName` is an exception: the string pointed to by `functionName` is a global constant and so may be accessed outside of the callback.

callbackSite.doc: Point in the runtime or driver function from where the callback was issued.

functionName.doc:
Name of the runtime or driver API function which issued the callback.

This string is a global constant and so may be accessed outside of the callback.

functionParams.doc:
Pointer to the arguments passed to the runtime or driver API call.

See generated_cuda_runtime_api_meta.h and generated_cuda_meta.h for structure definitions for the parameters for each runtime and driver API function.

functionReturnValue.doc:
Pointer to the return value of the runtime or driver API call.

This field is only valid within the exit::CUPTI_API_EXIT callback. For a runtime API `functionReturnValue` points to a `cudaError_t`. For a driver API `functionReturnValue` points to a `CUresult`.

symbolName.doc:
Name of the symbol operated on by the runtime or driver API function which issued the callback.

This entry is valid only for driver and runtime launch callbacks, where it returns the name of the kernel.

context.doc:
Driver context current to the thread, or null if no context is current.

This value can change from the entry to exit callback of a runtime API function if the runtime initializes a context.

contextUid.doc:
Unique ID for the CUDA context associated with the thread.

The UIDs are assigned sequentially as contexts are created and are unique within a process.

correlationData.doc:
Pointer to data shared between the entry and exit callbacks of a given runtime or drive API function invocation.

This field can be used to pass 64-bit values from the entry callback to the corresponding exit callback.

correlationId.doc:
The activity record correlation ID for this callback.

For a driver domain callback (i.e. `domain` [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_DRIVER_API`]) this ID will equal the correlation ID in the [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi) record corresponding to the CUDA driver function call. For a runtime domain callback (i.e. `domain` [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_RUNTIME_API`]) this ID will equal the correlation ID in the [CUpti_ActivityAPI](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityAPI.html#structcupti__activityapi) record corresponding to the CUDA runtime function call. Within the callback, this ID can be recorded to correlate user data with the activity record. This field is new in 4.1.

BufferInfo.doc: [BufferInfo](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUPTI_1_1PcSamplingUtil_1_1BufferInfo.html#structcupti_1_1pcsamplingutil_1_1bufferinfo) will be stored in the file for every buffer i.e for every call of UtilDumpPcSamplingBufferInFile() API.

numStallReasons.doc: Count of all stall reasons supported on the GPU.

numSelectedStallReasons.doc: Total number of stall reasons in single record.

CUpti_ActivitySharedAccess.doc:
The activity record for source-level shared access.

This activity records the locations of the shared accesses in the source ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SHARED_ACCESS`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SHARED_ACCESS`].

flags.doc: The properties of this shared access.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the access.

threadsExecuted.doc: This increments each time when this instruction is executed by number of threads that executed this instruction with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

sharedTransactions.doc: The total number of shared memory transactions generated by this access.

theoreticalSharedTransactions.doc: The minimum number of shared memory transactions possible based on the access pattern.

executed.doc:
The number of times this instruction was executed per warp.

It will be incremented when at least one of thread among warp is active with predicate and condition code evaluating to true.

profilerType.doc: [in] the profiler kind one from CUpti_ProfilerType.

pChipName.doc: [in] accepted for chips supported at the time-of-release.

pCounterAvailabilityImage.doc: [in] buffer with counter availability image - required for future chip support.

maxMetricsPerPass.doc: [out] maximum number of metrics that can be scheduled in a pass.

maxRegistersPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of 32-bit registers available per multiprocessor.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes being set by the memory set.

end.doc:

CUpti_ActivityMemoryPool.doc:
The activity record for memory pool.

This activity record represents a memory pool creation, destruction and trimming ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY_POOL`]). This activity record provides separate records for memory pool creation, destruction and trimming operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory pool operation.

memoryPoolOperationType.doc: The memory operation requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga878fb2c94e0051169fdf0ca7982612a2).

memoryPoolType.doc: The type of the memory pool, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory pool operation.

Each memory pool operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory operation.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory pool is created.

minBytesToKeep.doc:
The minimum bytes to keep of the memory pool.

`minBytesToKeep` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_OPERATION_TYPE_TRIMMED`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga878fb2c94e0051169fdf0ca7982612a2).

address.doc: The virtual address of the allocation.

size.doc:
The size of the memory pool operation in bytes.

`size` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

releaseThreshold.doc:
The release threshold of the memory pool.

`releaseThreshold` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

timestamp.doc: The start timestamp for the memory operation, in ns.

CUpti_ActivityKernel2.doc:
The activity record for kernel.

(deprecated)

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]) but is no longer generated by CUPTI. Kernel activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityKernel9](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel9.html#structcupti__activitykernel9) activity record.

executed.doc:

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.
