gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

counterDataImageSize.doc: [in] Size of the counter data image.

CUpti_Checkpoint.doc:
Configuration and handle for a CUPTI Checkpoint.

A CUptiCheckpoint object should be initialized with desired options prior to passing into any CUPTI Checkpoint API function. The first call into a Checkpoint API function will initialize internal state based on these options. Subsequent changes to these options will not have any effect.

Checkpoint data is saved in device, host, and filesystem space. There are options to reserve memory at each level (device, host, filesystem) which are intended to allow a guarantee that a certain amount of memory will remain free for use after the checkpoint is saved. Note, however, that falling back to slower levels of memory (host, and then filesystem) to save the checkpoint will result in performance degradation. Currently, the filesystem limitation is not implemented. Note that falling back to filesystem storage may significantly impact the performance for saving and restoring a checkpoint.

ctx.doc: [in] Set to context to save from, or will use current context if NULL.

reserveDeviceMB.doc: [in] Restrict checkpoint from using last N MB of device memory (-1 = use no device memory).

reserveHostMB.doc: [in] Restrict checkpoint from using last N MB of host memory (-1 = use no host memory).

allowOverwrite.doc: [in] Boolean, Allow checkpoint to save over existing checkpoint.

optimizations.doc: [in] Mask of CUpti_CheckpointOptimizations flags for this checkpoint.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

numRangesDropped.doc: [out] number of ranges whose data was dropped in the processed passes.

numTraceBytesDropped.doc: [out] number of bytes not written to TraceBuffer due to buffer full.

CUpti_ActivityAutoBoostState.doc:
Device auto boost state structure.

This structure defines auto boost state for a device. See function [cuptiGetAutoBoostState](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga1ac1cce5ce788b9f2c679d13e982384b).

enabled.doc:
Returned auto boost state.

1 is returned in case auto boost is enabled, 0 otherwise.

pid.doc:
Id of process that has set the current boost state.

The value will be CUPTI_AUTO_BOOST_INVALID_CLIENT_PID if the user does not have the permission to query process ids or there is an error in querying the process id.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

pRangeName.doc: [in] specifies the range for subsequent launches; must not be NULL.

rangeNameLength.doc: [in] assign to strlen(pRangeName) if known; if set to zero, the library will call strlen().

CUpti_ActivityOverhead.doc:
The activity record for CUPTI and driver overheads.

(Deprecated in CUDA 12.2)

This activity record provides CUPTI and driver overhead information (CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD). These records are now reported using [CUpti_ActivityOverhead3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOverhead3.html#structcupti__activityoverhead3).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD.

overheadKind.doc: The kind of overhead, CUPTI, DRIVER, COMPILER etc.

objectKind.doc: The kind of activity object that the overhead is associated with.

objectId.doc:
The identifier for the activity object.

‘objectKind’ indicates which ID is valid for this record.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the overhead, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the overhead.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the overhead, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the overhead.

CUpti_ActivityMemoryPool2.doc:
The activity record for memory pool.

This activity record represents a memory pool creation, destruction and trimming ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY_POOL`]). This activity record provides separate records for memory pool creation, destruction and trimming operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory pool operation.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY_POOL`].

memoryPoolOperationType.doc: The memory operation requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga878fb2c94e0051169fdf0ca7982612a2).

memoryPoolType.doc: The type of the memory pool, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory pool operation.

Each memory pool operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory operation.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory pool is created.

minBytesToKeep.doc:
The minimum bytes to keep of the memory pool.

`minBytesToKeep` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_OPERATION_TYPE_TRIMMED`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga878fb2c94e0051169fdf0ca7982612a2).

address.doc: The virtual address of the allocation.

size.doc:
The size of the memory pool operation in bytes.

`size` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

releaseThreshold.doc:
The release threshold of the memory pool.

`releaseThreshold` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

timestamp.doc: The start timestamp for the memory operation, in ns.

utilizedSize.doc:
The utilized size of the memory pool.

`utilizedSize` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

configImageSize.doc: [in] Number of bytes allocated for pConfigImage.

numOfPasses.doc: [out] number of passes required for profiling scheduled metrics in the config image.

ctx.doc: [in] CUDA context on which SASS metric data collection will be disabled. If set NULL, default context will be consider for SASS metric data collection.

numOfDroppedRecords.doc: [out] Num of dropped SASS records will be equal to numOfPatchedInstructions \* numOfInstances. Number of dropped records will be zero when data is flushed prior to calling the disable API.

CUpti_ActivityMetricInstance.doc:
The activity record for a CUPTI metric with instance information.

This activity record represents a CUPTI metric value for a specific metric domain instance ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC_INSTANCE`]). This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profile frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect metric data may choose to use this type to store the collected metric data. This activity record should be used when metric domain instance information needs to be associated with the metric.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC_INSTANCE`].

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the metric.

Use of this ID is user-defined, but typically this ID value will equal the correlation ID of the kernel for which the metric was gathered.

flags.doc:
The properties of this metric.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

CUpti_ActivityMemset.doc:
The activity record for memset.

(deprecated)

This activity record represents a memory set operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`].

value.doc: The value being assigned to memory by the memory set.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes being set by the memory set.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory set, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory set.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory set, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory set.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory set is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory set is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory set is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory set.

Each memory set is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the memory set.

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memset.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

memoryKind.doc:
The memory kind of the memory set.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

counterDataImageSize.doc: [in] Size of the counter data image.

structSize.doc: [in] Size of the data structure. CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

profilerType.doc: [in] the profiler kind one from CUpti_ProfilerType.

pChipName.doc: [in] accepted for chips supported at the time-of-release.

pCounterAvailabilityImage.doc: [in] buffer with counter availability image - required for future chip support.

pHostObject.doc: [out] binary blob allocated by CUPTI and operations associated with this object.

pSinglePassMetricSetName.doc: [in] the single pass metric set name, single pass metric set supported for a chip can be found using cuptiProfilerHostGetSinglePassSets API. Only valid for PM sampling, this can be set to NULL for range profiler.

CUpti_ActivityCudaEvent2.doc:
The activity record for CUDA event.

This activity is used to track recorded events. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CUDA_EVENT`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CUDA_EVENT`].

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the API to which this result is associated.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the event was recorded.

streamId.doc: The compute stream where the event was recorded.

eventId.doc: A unique event ID to identify the event record.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the event was recorded.

deviceTimestamp.doc:
The device-side timestamp on CUDA event record.

Timestamp is in nanoseconds. Collection of this field is disabled by default. It can be enabled by calling CUPTI API [cuptiActivityEnableCudaEventDeviceTimestamps](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga86a82dd4c053b885030dc12863c4b209).

cudaEventSyncId.doc:
A unique ID to associate event synchronization records with the latest CUDA Event record.

Similar field is added in [CUpti_ActivitySynchronization2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivitySynchronization2.html#structcupti__activitysynchronization2) to associate CUDA Event record to the synchronization record.

The same CUDA event can be used multiple times, so the event id will not be unique to correlate the synchronization record with the latest CUDA Event record. This field will be unique and can be used to do the required correlation.

CUpti_ActivityMemDecompress.doc:
The activity record for trace of decompression operations.

This activity record represents execution for a batch of decompression operatios. The activity kind is [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEM_DECOMPRESS`].

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEM_DECOMPRESS`].

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream.

channelID.doc: The ID of the HW channel on which the memory copy is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the decompression operations.

Each operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the operation.

numberOfOperations.doc: The number of operations in the batch.

sourceBytes.doc: The number of bytes to be read and decompressed in the batch operation.

reserved0.doc: This field is reserved for internal use.

start.doc:
The start timestamp.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the start time is unknown.

end.doc:
The end timestamp.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the start time is unknown.

CUpti_ActivityOverhead3.doc:
The activity record for CUPTI and driver overheads.

This activity record provides CUPTI and driver overhead information ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OVERHEAD`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD.

overheadKind.doc: The kind of overhead, CUPTI, DRIVER, COMPILER etc.

objectKind.doc: The kind of activity object that the overhead is associated with.

objectId.doc:
The identifier for the activity object.

‘objectKind’ indicates which ID is valid for this record.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the overhead, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the overhead.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the overhead, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the overhead.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the overhead operation to which records belong to.

This ID is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the overhead operation. In some cases, it can be zero, such as for [`CUpti_ActivityOverheadKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_CUPTI_BUFFER_FLUSH`] records.

overheadData.doc:
Pointer to the struct with additional details about the overhead.

Refer CUpti_ActivityOverheadKind enum and the corresponding structure to typecast and access additional overhead data. Client is responsible for freeing this memory using the free function when done.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter3.doc:
The activity record for Unified Memory counters (CUDA 7.0 and beyond)

This activity record represents a Unified Memory counter ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`].

value.doc:
Value of the counter For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`], [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`], CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THREASHING and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`], it is the size of the memory region in bytes.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`], it is the number of page fault groups for the same page. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`], it is the program counter for the instruction that caused fault.

start.doc:
The start timestamp of the counter, in ns.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`], timestamp is captured when activity starts on GPU. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver started processing the fault. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver detected thrashing of memory region. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`], timestamp is captured when throttling operation was started by CUDA driver. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver has pushed all required operations to the processor specified by dstId.

end.doc:
The end timestamp of the counter, in ns.

Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`]. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`], timestamp is captured when activity finishes on GPU. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver queues the replay of faulting memory accesses on the GPU For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`], timestamp is captured when throttling operation was finished by CUDA driver.

address.doc:
This is the virtual base address of the page/s being transferred.

For cpu and gpu faults, the virtual address for the page that faulted.

srcId.doc:
The ID of the source CPU/device involved in the memory transfer, page fault, thrashing, throttling or remote map operation.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`], it is a bitwise ORing of the device IDs fighting for the memory region, ONLY if there are less than 32 devices. Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`].

dstId.doc:
The ID of the destination CPU/device involved in the memory transfer or remote map operation.

Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`].

streamId.doc:
The ID of the stream causing the transfer.

This value of this field is invalid.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

flags.doc:
The flags associated with this record.

See enums [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryAccessType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga58bc092ea88426687492fdea7b1c0ff3) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] and [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryMigrationCause](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gac5e53db4204f170a6c31e520e080c1fc) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] and [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryRemoteMapCause](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gac38ad61408d643a789562314cd18d6b7) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`] and [CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`].

processors.doc:
The bitmask of devices involved in the operation.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`], it is a bitwise ORing of the device IDs fighting for the memory region. processors[0] represents the device ID of the device 0 to device 63, processors[1] represents device ID of device 64 to device 127 and so on. Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`] or CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_DTOD or CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_FAULT_REPLAY.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterConfig.doc:
Unified Memory counters configuration structure.

This structure controls the enable/disable of the various Unified Memory counters consisting of scope, kind and other parameters. See function [cuptiActivityConfigureUnifiedMemoryCounter](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8ec9b1229ba07a98aac9db4600d4325c).

scope.doc:
Unified Memory counter Counter scope.

(deprecated in CUDA 7.0).

kind.doc: Unified Memory counter Counter kind.

deviceId.doc:
Device id of the target device.

This is relevant only for single device scopes. (deprecated in CUDA 7.0).

enable.doc:
Control to enable/disable the counter.

To enable the counter set it to non-zero value while disable is indicated by zero.

pChipName.doc: [in] chip name for which metrics will be queried.

numOfMetrics.doc: [out] number of metrics supported for the queried chip.

pChipName.doc: [in] chip name for which metric will be queried.

metric.doc: [out] returns the metric ID and the metric description.

CUpti_ActivityMarkerData2.doc:
The activity record providing detailed information for a marker.

User must enable [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`] as well to get records for marker data. The marker data contains color, payload, and category. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER_DATA`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the marker.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

payloadKind.doc: Defines the payload format for the value associated with the marker.

cuptiDomainId.doc:
CUPTI maintained domain id required for NVTX extended payloads.

To parse the payload correctly, the domain id must be used to identify the payload attributes as they are domain specific.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpyPtoP3.doc:
The activity record for peer-to-peer memory copies.

(deprecated in CUDA 11.6)

This activity record represents a peer-to-peer memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

CUpti_ActivityKernel.doc:
The activity record for kernel.

(deprecated)

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]) but is no longer generated by CUPTI. cacheConfigExecuted.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the kernel.

runtimeCorrelationId.doc:
The runtime correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique runtime correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

CUpti_PCSamplingConfigurationInfoParams.doc:
PC sampling configuration structure.

This structure configures PC sampling using [cuptiPCSamplingSetConfigurationAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__PCSAMPLING__API.html#group__cupti__pcsampling__api_1gaf3e8842fda99b4c1659c2d2f1c18674e) and queries PC sampling default configuration using [cuptiPCSamplingGetConfigurationAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__PCSAMPLING__API.html#group__cupti__pcsampling__api_1gada8f3c53c8673e56a689a67cae7e8df2).

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingConfigurationInfoParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

ctx.doc: [w] CUcontext.

numAttributes.doc: [w] Number of attributes to configure using [cuptiPCSamplingSetConfigurationAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__PCSAMPLING__API.html#group__cupti__pcsampling__api_1gaf3e8842fda99b4c1659c2d2f1c18674e) or query using [cuptiPCSamplingGetConfigurationAttribute](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__PCSAMPLING__API.html#group__cupti__pcsampling__api_1gada8f3c53c8673e56a689a67cae7e8df2).

CUpti_StreamAttrData.doc:
Stream attribute data passed into a resource callback function for [`CUpti_CallbackIdResource::CUPTI_CBID_RESOURCE_STREAM_ATTRIBUTE_CHANGED`] callback.

Data passed into a resource callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_RESOURCE`]. The stream attribute data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data.

stream.doc: The CUDA stream handle for the attribute.

attr.doc: The type of the CUDA stream attribute.

value.doc: The value of the CUDA stream attribute.

CUpti_ActivityOverheadCommandBufferFullD.doc: The structure to provide additional data for [`CUpti_ActivityOverheadKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_COMMAND_BUFFER_FULL`].

commandBufferLength.doc:

This field will always be zero when the command buffer is full, making it not useful in such cases.

channelID.doc: The channel ID of the command buffer.

channelType.doc: The channel type of the command buffer.

pRangeName.doc: [in] Name of the range to be profiled (only valid for User range mode).

pMetricNames.doc: [in] Names of the metrics to be collected.

numMetrics.doc: [in] Number of metrics to be collected.

maxSamples.doc: [in] Maximum number of samples to be stored in the counter data image.

counterDataSize.doc: [out] Size of the counter data image.

CUpti_ActivityJit2.doc:
The activity record for JIT operations.

This activity represents the JIT operations (compile, load, store) of a CUmodule from the Compute Cache. Gives the exact hashed path of where the cached module is loaded from, or where the module will be stored after Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation.

kind.doc: The activity record kind must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_JIT`].

deviceId.doc: The device ID.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the JIT operation, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the JIT operation.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the JIT operation, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the JIT operation.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the JIT operation to which records belong to.

Each JIT operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the JIT operation.

jitOperationCorrelationId.doc:
The correlation ID to correlate JIT compilation, load and store operations.

Each JIT compilation unit is assigned a unique correlation ID at the time of the JIT compilation. This correlation id can be used to find the matching JIT cache load/store records.

cachePath.doc: The path where the fat binary is cached.

processId.doc: The ID of the process where the JIT operation is executing.

threadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the JIT operation is executing.

CUpti_ActivityKernel7.doc:
The activity record for kernel.

(deprecated in CUDA 11.8)

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]) but is no longer generated by CUPTI. Kernel activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityKernel9](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel9.html#structcupti__activitykernel9) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

requested.doc:
The cache configuration requested by the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

executed.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

cacheConfig.doc: For devices with compute capability 7.5+ cacheConfig values are not updated in case field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:
The shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUsharedconfig enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

partitionedGlobalCacheRequested.doc:
The partitioned global caching requested for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2.

partitionedGlobalCacheExecuted.doc:
The partitioned global caching executed for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2. Partitioned global caching can be automatically disabled if the occupancy requirement of the launch cannot support caching.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

completed.doc:
The completed timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

It represents the completion of all it’s child kernels and the kernel itself. A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the completion time is unknown.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

queued.doc:
The timestamp when the kernel is queued up in the command buffer, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

Command buffer is a buffer written by CUDA driver to send commands like kernel launch, memory copy etc to the GPU. All launches of CUDA kernels are asynchronous with respect to the host, the host requests the launch by writing commands into the command buffer, then returns without checking the GPU’s progress.

submitted.doc:
The timestamp when the command buffer containing the kernel launch is submitted to the GPU, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the submitted time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

launchType.doc:
The indicates if the kernel was executed via a regular launch or via a single/multi device cooperative launch.

See also

The value will be updated only if field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

This field will be 0 if the kernel is not launched through graph launch APIs.

The pointer to the access policy window.

The structure CUaccessPolicyWindow is defined in cuda.h.

channelID.doc: The ID of the HW channel on which the kernel is launched.

CUpti_ActivitySynchronization2.doc:
The activity record for synchronization management.

This activity is used to track various CUDA synchronization APIs. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SYNCHRONIZATION`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_SYNCHRONIZATION`].

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the function, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the function.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the function, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the function.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the API to which this result is associated.

The ID of the context for which the synchronization API is called.

In case of context synchronization API it is the context id for which the API is called. In case of stream/event synchronization it is the ID of the context where the stream/event was created.

streamId.doc:
The compute stream for which the synchronization API is called.

A CUPTI_SYNCHRONIZATION_INVALID_VALUE value indicate the field is not applicable for this record. Not valid for cuCtxSynchronize, cuEventSynchronize.

cudaEventId.doc:
The event ID for which the synchronization API is called.

A CUPTI_SYNCHRONIZATION_INVALID_VALUE value indicate the field is not applicable for this record. Not valid for cuCtxSynchronize, cuStreamSynchronize.

cudaEventSyncId.doc:
A unique ID to associate event synchronization records with the latest CUDA Event record.

Similar field is added in [CUpti_ActivityCudaEvent2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityCudaEvent2.html#structcupti__activitycudaevent2) to associate synchronization record to the CUDA Event record.

The same CUDA event can be used multiple times, so the event id will not be unique to correlate the synchronization record with the latest CUDA Event record. This field will be unique and can be used to do the required correlation.

A CUPTI_SYNCHRONIZATION_INVALID_VALUE value indicates that the field is not applicable for this record. Valid only for synchronization records related to CUDA Events.

returnValue.doc:
The return value for the synchronization record.

Use cuptiActivityEnableAllSyncRecords API to enable/disable collection of synchronization records with return value being non-zero. This will be a CUresult value.

hardwareBufferSize.doc: [in] The hardware buffer size in which raw PM sampling data will be stored. These samples will be decoded to counter data image with [cuptiPmSamplingDecodeData](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__PM__SAMPLING__API.html#group__cupti__pm__sampling__api_1ga1e0f1d1e28911b48feca1013ce7e8b2f) call.

samplingInterval.doc: [in] For the trigger mode [`CUpti_PmSampling_TriggerMode::CUPTI_PM_SAMPLING_TRIGGER_MODE_GPU_SYSCLK_INTERVAL`], sampling interval is the number of sys clock cycles. For the trigger mode [`CUpti_PmSampling_TriggerMode::CUPTI_PM_SAMPLING_TRIGGER_MODE_GPU_TIME_INTERVAL`], sampling interval is in nanoseconds.

triggerMode.doc: [in] Trigger mode. Note: [`CUpti_PmSampling_TriggerMode::CUPTI_PM_SAMPLING_TRIGGER_MODE_GPU_TIME_INTERVAL`] is not supported in Turing and GA100. Supported from GA10x onwards.

For KEEP_OLDEST mode, all the records will be kept in the buffer and in case hardware buffer is getting filled up. overflow will be set to 1 in [CUpti_PmSampling_DecodeData_Params](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__PmSampling__DecodeData__Params.html#structcupti__pmsampling__decodedata__params). CUpti_ActivityGreenContext2.doc:
The activity record for a green context (version 2).

This activity record represents information about a green context ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`]). This is an enhanced version of [CUpti_ActivityGreenContext](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGreenContext.html#structcupti__activitygreencontext) that adds work queue configuration fields.

The corresponding activity kind is [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`].

Green contexts enable resource partitioning by allocating a subset of SMs (Streaming Multiprocessors) from the GPU to a context.

**TPC (Thread Processing Cluster)**
:   Thread Processing Clusters are hardware units within a GPC (Graphics Processing Cluster). Each TPC contains one or more SMs, along with texture units, L1 cache, instruction cache, and constant cache. Green contexts allocate resources at the TPC level.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`].

contextId.doc: The context ID of the green context.

parentContextId.doc: The ID of the parent context.

deviceId.doc: The device ID associated with the green context.

numTpcs.doc: The number of TPCs allocated to the green context.

numMultiprocessors.doc: The number of multiprocessors (SMs) allocated to the green context.

logicalTpcMaskSize.doc: The size (in 32-bit words) of the logical TPC mask stored in logicalTpcMask[].

logicalTpcMask.doc:
Bitset of allocated TPC IDs represented as 32-bit words.

Valid words are specified by logicalTpcMaskSize; unused entries are zeroed. The array supports up to 1024 TPCs (32 words × 32 bits). Each bit represents a logical TPC ID assigned to the green context. For example, if bit k is set, logical TPC ID k is assigned to the context.

**Example: Interpreting the TPC Mask**
:   For a green context with numTpcs=3, logicalTpcMaskSize=8, and logicalTpcMask={66,8,0,0,0,0,0,0}:

* Word 0: Value 66 (binary: …01000010, showing lowest 8 bits of 32-bit word) indicates TPCs 1 and 6
* Word 1: Value 8 (binary: …00001000) indicates TPC 35 (bit 3 of word 1, i.e., global TPC ID 32+3)
* Each word is 32 bits covering TPCs 0-31 (word 0), 32-63 (word 1), etc.
* To check if TPC N is allocated: (logicalTpcMask[N/32] & (1U << (N%32)))
* logicalTpcMaskSize indicates how many words in the array contain valid data.

workqueueResourceId.doc:
The work queue resource ID associated with the green context.

This is a unique identifier for the work queue resource used by this green context.

workqueueConcurrencyLimit.doc:
The concurrency limit for the work queue associated with the green context.

This defines the maximum number of concurrent operations allowed on this work queue.

workqueueSharingScope.doc:
The sharing scope for the work queue associated with the green context.

This defines how the work queue can be shared across different contexts or processes. Refer.

size.doc:
Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingDisableParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

bufferType.doc: Type of buffer to store in file.

pPCSamplingConfigurationInfo.doc: Refer [CUpti_PCSamplingConfigurationInfo](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__PCSamplingConfigurationInfo.html#structcupti__pcsamplingconfigurationinfo) It is expected to provide configuration details of at least [`CUpti_PCSamplingConfigurationAttributeType::CUPTI_PC_SAMPLING_CONFIGURATION_ATTR_TYPE_STALL_REASON`] attribute.

fileName.doc: File name to store buffer into it.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

numRangesDropped.doc: [out] number of ranges whose data was dropped in the processed pass.

numTraceBytesDropped.doc: [out] number of bytes not written to TraceBuffer due to buffer full.

onePassCollected.doc: [out] true if a pass was successfully decoded.

allPassesCollected.doc: [out] becomes true when the last pass has been decoded.

counterDataImageSize.doc: [in] Size of the counter data image.

maxRangesPerPass.doc: [in] Maximum number of ranges that can be profiled in a pass.

numNestingLevels.doc: [in] number of nesting level to be profiled. For Auto range mode, this should be set to 1.

minNestingLevel.doc: [in] minimum nesting level to be profiled.

passIndex.doc: [in] Pass index for the replay session.

targetNestingLevel.doc: [in] Target nesting level for the replay session.

CUpti_ActivityGraphTrace2.doc:
The activity record for trace of graph execution.

This activity record represents execution for a graph without giving visibility about the execution of its nodes. This is intended to reduce overheads in tracing each node. The activity kind is [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`].

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_TRACE`].

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the graph launch.

Each graph launch is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the graph.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the graph.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the graph.

deviceId.doc:
The ID of the device where the first node of the graph is executed.

If this is INT_MAX, then the start is on the host.

graphId.doc: The unique ID of the graph that is launched.

contextId.doc:
The ID of the context where the first node of the graph is executed.

If this is INT_MAX, then the start is on the host.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the graph is being launched.

reserved.doc: This field is reserved for internal use.

endDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where last node of the graph is executed.

endContextId.doc: The ID of the context where the last node of the graph is executed.

CUpti_ActivityDevice2.doc:
The activity record for a device.

(deprecated)

This activity record represents information about a GPU device ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`]). Device activity is now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the device.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

globalMemoryBandwidth.doc: The global memory bandwidth available on the device, in kBytes/sec.

globalMemorySize.doc: The amount of global memory on the device, in bytes.

constantMemorySize.doc: The amount of constant memory on the device, in bytes.

l2CacheSize.doc: The size of the L2 cache on the device, in bytes.

numThreadsPerWarp.doc: The number of threads per warp on the device.

coreClockRate.doc: The core clock rate of the device, in kHz.

numMemcpyEngines.doc: Number of memory copy engines on the device.

numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors on the device.

maxIPC.doc: The maximum “instructions per cycle” possible on each device multiprocessor.

maxWarpsPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of warps that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxBlocksPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of blocks that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory available per multiprocessor, in bytes.

maxRegistersPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of 32-bit registers available per multiprocessor.

maxRegistersPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of registers that can be allocated to a block.

maxSharedMemoryPerBlock.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory that can be assigned to a block, in bytes.

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of threads allowed in a block.

maxBlockDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a block.

maxGridDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a grid.

computeCapabilityMajor.doc: Compute capability for the device, major number.

computeCapabilityMinor.doc: Compute capability for the device, minor number.

uuid.doc:
The device UUID.

This value is the globally unique immutable alphanumeric identifier of the device.

name.doc:
The device name.

This name is shared across all activity records representing instances of the device, and so should not be modified.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

maxRangesPerPass.doc: [in] Maximum number of ranges that can be recorded in a single pass.

maxLaunchesPerPass.doc: [in] Maximum number of kernel launches that can be recorded in a single pass; must be >= maxRangesPerPass.

CUpti_ActivityDevice6.doc:
The activity record for a device.

This activity record represents information about a GPU device ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the device.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

globalMemoryBandwidth.doc: The global memory bandwidth available on the device, in kBytes/sec.

globalMemorySize.doc: The amount of global memory on the device, in bytes.

constantMemorySize.doc: The amount of constant memory on the device, in bytes.

l2CacheSize.doc: The size of the L2 cache on the device, in bytes.

numThreadsPerWarp.doc: The number of threads per warp on the device.

coreClockRate.doc: The core clock rate of the device, in kHz.

numMemcpyEngines.doc: Number of memory copy engines on the device.

numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors on the device.

maxIPC.doc: The maximum “instructions per cycle” possible on each device multiprocessor.

maxWarpsPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of warps that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxBlocksPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of blocks that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory available per multiprocessor, in bytes.

maxRegistersPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of 32-bit registers available per multiprocessor.

maxRegistersPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of registers that can be allocated to a block.

maxSharedMemoryPerBlock.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory that can be assigned to a block, in bytes.

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of threads allowed in a block.

maxBlockDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a block.

maxGridDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a grid.

computeCapabilityMajor.doc: Compute capability for the device, major number.

computeCapabilityMinor.doc: Compute capability for the device, minor number.

uuid.doc:
The device UUID.

This value is the globally unique immutable alphanumeric identifier of the device.

name.doc:
The device name.

Client is responsible for freeing this memory using the free function when done.

isCudaVisible.doc:
Flag to indicate whether the device is visible to CUDA.

Users can set the device visibility using CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES environment.

gpuInstanceId.doc:
GPU Instance id for MIG enabled devices.

If mig mode is disabled value is set to UINT32_MAX.

computeInstanceId.doc:
Compute Instance id for MIG enabled devices.

If mig mode is disabled value is set to UINT32_MAX.

migUuid.doc:
The MIG UUID.

This value is the globally unique immutable alphanumeric identifier of the device.

isNumaNode.doc: Numa (Non-uniform memory access) information for device GPU is a NUMA node or not.

numaId.doc: Numa (Non-uniform memory access) information for device NUMA node ID of the GPU memory if GPU is not a NUMA node, it returns invalidNumaId.

numTpcs.doc: Number of TPCs on the device.

reserved0.doc:
Undefined.

Reserved for internal use to maintain 8-byte alignment.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpy5.doc:
The activity record for memory copies.

This activity record represents a memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`]).

Structure deprecated in CUDA 12.8: Refer to [CUpti_ActivityMemcpy6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemcpy6.html#structcupti__activitymemcpy6) for the latest structure.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the memory copy.

runtimeCorrelationId.doc:
The runtime correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique runtime correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the runtime API activity record that launched the memory copy.

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that executed this memcpy through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memcpy is not done through graph launch.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that executed this memcpy through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memcpy is not done through graph launch.

channelID.doc: The ID of the HW channel on which the memory copy is occurring.

CUpti_ActivityOverhead2.doc:
The activity record for CUPTI and driver overheads.

This activity record provides CUPTI and driver overhead information (CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD.

overheadKind.doc: The kind of overhead, CUPTI, DRIVER, COMPILER etc.

objectKind.doc: The kind of activity object that the overhead is associated with.

objectId.doc:
The identifier for the activity object.

‘objectKind’ indicates which ID is valid for this record.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the overhead, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the overhead.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the overhead, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the overhead.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the overhead operation to which records belong to.

This ID is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the overhead operation. In some cases, it can be zero, such as for [`CUpti_ActivityOverheadKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_OVERHEAD_CUPTI_BUFFER_FLUSH`] records.

samples.doc: [r] Number of times the PC was sampled with the stallReason.

ctx.doc: [in] CUDA context on which SASS metric data collection was enabled. If set NULL, default context will be consider for SASS metric data collection.

numOfPatchedInstructionRecords.doc: [in] number of patched instruction record will be retrived, user can call [cuptiSassMetricsGetDataProperties()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__SASS__METRICS__API.html#group__cupti__sass__metrics__api_1ga2601b1a5b4fe4b9253cdb81f04120b1e) for getting total number of records available.

numOfInstances.doc: [in] number of patched instruction record instances for a metric, user can call [cuptiSassMetricsGetDataProperties()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__SASS__METRICS__API.html#group__cupti__sass__metrics__api_1ga2601b1a5b4fe4b9253cdb81f04120b1e) for getting total number of instances for each record per metric available.

CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousEvent.doc:
The activity record for an instantaneous CUPTI event.

This activity record represents a CUPTI event value ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT`]) sampled at a particular instant. This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profiler frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect event data at a particular time may choose to use this type to store the collected event data.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_EVENT`].

timestamp.doc: The timestamp at which event is sampled.

deviceId.doc: The device id.

CUpti_GraphData.doc:
CUDA graphs data passed into a resource callback function.

CUDA graphs data passed into a resource callback function as the `cbdata` argument to [CUpti_CallbackFunc](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__CALLBACK__API.html#group__cupti__callback__api_1ga21bab4f7f7e04488b0e7edcea9f5a49c). The `cbdata` will be this type for `domain` equal to [`CUpti_CallbackDomain::CUPTI_CB_DOMAIN_RESOURCE`]. The graph data is valid only within the invocation of the callback function that is passed the data. If you need to retain some data for use outside of the callback, you must make a copy of that data.

originalGraph.doc: The original CUDA graph from which.

originalNode.doc: The original CUDA graph node from which.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter2.doc:
The activity record for Unified Memory counters (deprecated in 12.8)

This activity record represents a Unified Memory counter ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`].

value.doc:
Value of the counter For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`], [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`], CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THREASHING and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`], it is the size of the memory region in bytes.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`], it is the number of page fault groups for the same page. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`], it is the program counter for the instruction that caused fault.

start.doc:
The start timestamp of the counter, in ns.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`], timestamp is captured when activity starts on GPU. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver started processing the fault. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver detected thrashing of memory region. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`], timestamp is captured when throttling operation was started by CUDA driver. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver has pushed all required operations to the processor specified by dstId.

end.doc:
The end timestamp of the counter, in ns.

Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`]. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] and [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_DTOH`], timestamp is captured when activity finishes on GPU. For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`], timestamp is captured when CUDA driver queues the replay of faulting memory accesses on the GPU For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`], timestamp is captured when throttling operation was finished by CUDA driver.

address.doc:
This is the virtual base address of the page/s being transferred.

For cpu and gpu faults, the virtual address for the page that faulted.

srcId.doc:
The ID of the source CPU/device involved in the memory transfer, page fault, thrashing, throttling or remote map operation.

For counterKind [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`], it is a bitwise ORing of the device IDs fighting for the memory region. Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`].

dstId.doc:
The ID of the destination CPU/device involved in the memory transfer or remote map operation.

Ignore this field if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_CPU_PAGE_FAULT_COUNT`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`].

streamId.doc:
The ID of the stream causing the transfer.

This value of this field is invalid.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

flags.doc:
The flags associated with this record.

See enums [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryAccessType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga58bc092ea88426687492fdea7b1c0ff3) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_GPU_PAGE_FAULT`] and [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryMigrationCause](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gac5e53db4204f170a6c31e520e080c1fc) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_BYTES_TRANSFER_HTOD`] and [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryRemoteMapCause](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gac38ad61408d643a789562314cd18d6b7) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_REMOTE_MAP`] and [CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639) if counterKind is [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THRASHING`] or [`CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER_KIND_THROTTLING`].

CUpti_ActivityDeviceGraphTrace.doc:
The activity record for trace of device graph execution.

This activity record represents execution for a device launched graph without giving visibility about the execution of its nodes. This is intended to reduce overheads in tracing each node. The activity kind is [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE`].

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_GRAPH_TRACE`].

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the first node of the graph is executed.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the graph.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the graph execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the graph.

graphId.doc: The unique ID of the graph that is launched.

launcherGraphId.doc: The unique ID of the graph that has launched this graph.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the first node of the graph is executed.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the graph is being launched.

reserved.doc: This field is reserved for internal use.

numOfMetricConfig.doc: [in] num of metric configs, will be equal to number of metrics queried.

pConfigs.doc: [in] list of metric config generated for given sass metrics.

deviceIndex.doc: [in] device index for which config will be set, user can call this once for the device on which the SASS metric data will be collected.

CUpti_ActivityCdpKernel.doc:
The activity record for CDP (CUDA Dynamic Parallelism) kernel.

This activity record represents a CDP kernel execution.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CDP_KERNEL`].

requested.doc:
The cache configuration requested by the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

executed.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:
The shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUsharedconfig enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique grid ID.

parentGridId.doc: The grid ID of the parent kernel.

queued.doc:
The timestamp when kernel is queued up, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time is unknown.

submitted.doc:
The timestamp when kernel is submitted to the gpu, in ns.

completed.doc:

parentBlockY.doc: The Y-dimension of the parent block.

name.doc:

CUpti_ActivityOpenAccLaunch.doc:
The activity record for OpenACC launch.

([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_LAUNCH`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_LAUNCH`].

eventKind.doc:
CUPTI OpenACC event kind (.

See also

[CUpti_OpenAccEventKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga0e638b0b6a210164345ab159bcba6717)).

parentConstruct.doc:
CUPTI OpenACC parent construct kind (.

Note that for applications using PGI OpenACC runtime < 16.1, this will always be [`CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind::CUPTI_OPENACC_CONSTRUCT_KIND_UNKNOWN`].

See also

[CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaad1f871f3bfe3f626520561cc767881e)).

implicit.doc: 1 for any implicit event, such as an implicit wait at a synchronous data construct 0 otherwise.

async.doc: Value of [async()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAccLaunch.html#structcupti__activityopenacclaunch_1a9a88f776fbccfc4f9660636a9d8cc46e) clause of the corresponding directive.

lineNo.doc:
The line number of the directive or program construct or the starting line number of the OpenACC construct corresponding to the event.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

endLineNo.doc:
For an OpenACC construct, this contains the line number of the end of the construct.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

funcLineNo.doc:
The line number of the first line of the function named in func_name.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

funcEndLineNo.doc:
The last line number of the function named in func_name.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

start.doc: CUPTI start timestamp.

end.doc: CUPTI end timestamp.

cuDeviceId.doc: CUDA device id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuContextId.doc: CUDA context id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuStreamId.doc: CUDA stream id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuProcessId.doc: The ID of the process where the OpenACC activity is executing.

cuThreadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the OpenACC activity is executing.

externalId.doc:
The OpenACC correlation ID.

Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia. If not 0, it uniquely identifies this record. It is identical to the externalId in the preceding external correlation record of type [`CUpti_ExternalCorrelationKind::CUPTI_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_KIND_OPENACC`].

srcFile.doc: A pointer to null-terminated string containing the name of or path to the source file, if known, or a null pointer if not.

funcName.doc: A pointer to a null-terminated string containing the name of the function in which the event occurred.

numGangs.doc: The number of gangs created for this kernel launch.

numWorkers.doc: The number of workers created for this kernel launch.

vectorLength.doc: The number of vector lanes created for this kernel launch.

kernelName.doc: A pointer to null-terminated string containing the name of the kernel being launched, if known, or a null pointer if not.

CUpti_ActivityBranch.doc:
The activity record for source level result branch.

(deprecated)

This activity record the locations of the branches in the source ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_BRANCH`]). Branch activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityBranch2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityBranch2.html#structcupti__activitybranch2) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_BRANCH`].

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the branch.

executed.doc:
The number of times this instruction was executed per warp.

It will be incremented regardless of predicate or condition code.

diverged.doc: Number of times this branch diverged.

threadsExecuted.doc: This increments each time when this instruction is executed by number of threads that executed this instruction.

pHostObject.doc: [in] reference to the profiler host object allocated by CUPTI in cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

ppMetricNames.doc: [out] list of base metrics supported of queried metric type for the chip.

CUpti_ActivityMarker.doc:
The activity record providing a marker which is an instantaneous point in time.

(deprecated in CUDA 8.0)

The marker is specified with a descriptive name and unique id ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`]). Marker activity is now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityMarker2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMarker2.html#structcupti__activitymarker2) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MARKER`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the marker.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

timestamp.doc:
The timestamp for the marker, in ns.

A value of 0 indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the marker.

objectKind.doc: The kind of activity object associated with this marker.

objectId.doc:
The identifier for the activity object associated with this marker.

‘objectKind’ indicates which ID is valid for this record.

name.doc:
The marker name for an instantaneous or start marker.

This will be NULL for an end marker.

CUpti_ActivityKernel5.doc:
The activity record for a kernel (CUDA 11.0(with sm_80 support) onwards).

executed.doc:

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2. Partitioned global caching can be automatically disabled if the occupancy requirement of the launch cannot support caching.

end.doc:
