queued.doc:
The timestamp when the kernel is queued up in the command buffer, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

All launches of CUDA kernels are asynchronous with respect to the host, the host requests the launch by writing commands into the command buffer, then returns without checking the GPU’s progress.

l2_transactions.doc: The total number of 32 bytes transactions to L2 cache generated by this access.

theoreticalL2Transactions.doc: The minimum number of L2 transactions possible based on the access pattern.

CUpti_ActivityNvLink5.doc:
NVLink information.

This structure gives capabilities of each logical NVLink connection between two devices, gpu<->gpu or gpu<->CPU which can be used to understand the topology.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NVLINK`].

uuidDev.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 0.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 1.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6).

npu.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

idDev0.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 0.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

idDev1.doc:
If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 1.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

flag.doc:
Flag gives capabilities of the link.

See also

[CUpti_LinkFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga819d686d23d2a3dfed9cc1d3c4ecb162).

physicalNvLinkCount.doc: Number of physical NVLinks present between two devices.

portDev0.doc:
Port numbers for NVLinks connected to device 0.

If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology. CUPTI dynamically allocates memory using the malloc() function for physicalNvLinkCount ports. Client is responsible for freeing this memory using the free() function when done.

portDev1.doc:
Port numbers for NVLinks connected to device 1.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology. CUPTI dynamically allocates memory using the malloc() function for physicalNvLinkCount ports. Client is responsible for freeing this memory using the free() function when done.

nvswitchConnected.doc: NVSwitch is connected as an intermediate node.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc:
The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes (deprecated in CUDA 11.8).

Refer field localMemoryTotal_v2.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

queued.doc:
The timestamp when the kernel is queued up in the command buffer, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

Command buffer is a buffer written by CUDA driver to send commands like kernel launch, memory copy etc to the GPU. All launches of CUDA kernels are asynchronous with respect to the host, the host requests the launch by writing commands into the command buffer, then returns without checking the GPU’s progress.

submitted.doc:
The timestamp when the command buffer containing the kernel launch is submitted to the GPU, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the submitted time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.

launchType.doc:
The indicates if the kernel was executed via a regular launch or via a single/multi device cooperative launch.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityLaunchType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gad054e12847a4a5a0ece53d2cb6dc6d8c).

isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested.doc: This indicates if CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_PREFERRED_SHARED_MEMORY_CARVEOUT was updated for the kernel launch.

sharedMemoryCarveoutRequested.doc:
Shared memory carveout value requested for the function in percentage of the total resource.

The value will be updated only if field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryExecuted.doc: Shared memory size set by the driver.

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

This field will be 0 if the kernel is not launched through graph launch APIs.

shmemLimitConfig.doc:
The shared memory limit config for the kernel.

This field shows whether user has opted for a higher per block limit of dynamic shared memory.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that launched this kernel through graph launch APIs.

This field will be 0 if the kernel is not launched through graph launch APIs.

pAccessPolicyWindow.doc:
The pointer to the access policy window.

The structure CUaccessPolicyWindow is defined in cuda.h.

channelID.doc: The ID of the HW channel on which the kernel is launched.

clusterX.doc:
The X-dimension cluster size for the kernel.

Field is valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

clusterY.doc:
The Y-dimension cluster size for the kernel.

Field is valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

clusterZ.doc:
The Z-dimension cluster size for the kernel.

Field is valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

clusterSchedulingPolicy.doc:
The cluster scheduling policy for the kernel.

Refer CUclusterSchedulingPolicy Field is valid for devices with compute capability 9.0 and higher.

localMemoryTotal_v2.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

maxPotentialClusterSize.doc: The maximum cluster size for the kernel.

maxActiveClusters.doc: The maximum clusters that could co-exist on the target device for the kernel.

isDeviceLaunched.doc: This field is set to 1 if the kernel is part of a device launched graph.

CUpti_ActivityMemset4.doc:
The activity record for memset.

This activity record represents a memory set operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`].

value.doc: The value being assigned to memory by the memory set.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes being set by the memory set.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory set, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory set.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory set, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory set.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory set is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory set is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory set is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory set.

Each memory set is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the memory set.

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memset.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

memoryKind.doc:
The memory kind of the memory set.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that executed this memset through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memset is not executed through graph launch.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that executed this memset through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memset is not executed through graph launch.

channelID.doc: The ID of the HW channel on which the memory set is occurring.

isDeviceLaunched.doc: This field is used to indicate if the memset operation is part of a device graph launch.

size.doc:
Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingDisableParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

CUpti_ActivityMemory4.doc:
The activity record for memory.

This activity record represents a memory allocation and free operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2`]). This activity record provides separate records for memory allocation and memory release operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory operation.

Note: This activity record is an upgrade over [CUpti_ActivityMemory](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory.html#structcupti__activitymemory) enabled using the kind [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ggaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3afee93ef030088d7a992a1abd6d6e53b0). [CUpti_ActivityMemory](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory.html#structcupti__activitymemory) provides a single record for the memory allocation and memory release operations.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2`].

memoryOperationType.doc: The memory operation requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga6404b89cfbbd60e04204244d230b15c4).

memoryKind.doc: The memory kind requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory operation.

Each memory operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory operation.

address.doc:
The virtual address of the allocation.

The base address of the memory pool.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes of memory allocated.

timestamp.doc: The start timestamp for the memory operation, in ns.

PC.doc: The program counter of the memory operation.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory operation is taking place.

contextId.doc:
The ID of the context.

If context is NULL, `contextId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_CONTEXT_ID.

streamId.doc:
The ID of the stream.

If memory operation is not async, `streamId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_STREAM_ID.

name.doc:
Variable name.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same symbol, and so should not be modified.

isAsync.doc: `isAsync` is set if memory operation happens through async memory APIs.

memoryPoolType.doc: The type of the memory pool, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

releaseThreshold.doc:
The release threshold of the memory pool in bytes.

`releaseThreshold` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

pool.doc:
The size of memory pool in bytes and the processId of the memory pools `size` is valid if `memoryPoolType` is [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

`processId` is valid if `memoryPoolType` is [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_IMPORTED`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

utilizedSize.doc:
The utilized size of the memory pool.

`utilizedSize` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

memoryPoolConfig.doc: The memory pool configuration used for the memory operations.

source.doc: The shared object or binary that the memory allocation request comes from.

PcSamplingStallReasons.doc: All available stall reasons name and respective indexes will be stored in it.

numStallReasons.doc: Number of all available stall reasons.

stallReasons.doc: Stall reasons names of all available stall reasons.

stallReasonIndex.doc: Stall reason index of all available stall reasons.

CUpti_ActivityDevice4.doc:
The activity record for a device.

(CUDA 11.6 onwards)

This activity record represents information about a GPU device ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`]). Device activity is now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the device.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

globalMemoryBandwidth.doc: The global memory bandwidth available on the device, in kBytes/sec.

globalMemorySize.doc: The amount of global memory on the device, in bytes.

constantMemorySize.doc: The amount of constant memory on the device, in bytes.

l2CacheSize.doc: The size of the L2 cache on the device, in bytes.

numThreadsPerWarp.doc: The number of threads per warp on the device.

coreClockRate.doc: The core clock rate of the device, in kHz.

numMemcpyEngines.doc: Number of memory copy engines on the device.

numMultiprocessors.doc: Number of multiprocessors on the device.

maxIPC.doc: The maximum “instructions per cycle” possible on each device multiprocessor.

maxWarpsPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of warps that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxBlocksPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of blocks that can be present on a multiprocessor at any given time.

maxSharedMemoryPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory available per multiprocessor, in bytes.

maxRegistersPerMultiprocessor.doc: Maximum number of 32-bit registers available per multiprocessor.

maxRegistersPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of registers that can be allocated to a block.

maxSharedMemoryPerBlock.doc: Maximum amount of shared memory that can be assigned to a block, in bytes.

maxThreadsPerBlock.doc: Maximum number of threads allowed in a block.

maxBlockDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a block.

maxBlockDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a block.

maxGridDimX.doc: Maximum allowed X dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimY.doc: Maximum allowed Y dimension for a grid.

maxGridDimZ.doc: Maximum allowed Z dimension for a grid.

computeCapabilityMajor.doc: Compute capability for the device, major number.

computeCapabilityMinor.doc: Compute capability for the device, minor number.

uuid.doc:
The device UUID.

This value is the globally unique immutable alphanumeric identifier of the device.

name.doc:
The device name.

This name is shared across all activity records representing instances of the device, and so should not be modified.

isCudaVisible.doc:
Flag to indicate whether the device is visible to CUDA.

Users can set the device visibility using CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES environment.

gpuInstanceId.doc:
GPU Instance id for MIG enabled devices.

If mig mode is disabled value is set to UINT32_MAX.

computeInstanceId.doc:
Compute Instance id for MIG enabled devices.

If mig mode is disabled value is set to UINT32_MAX.

migUuid.doc:
The MIG UUID.

This value is the globally unique immutable alphanumeric identifier of the device.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

CUpti_ActivityEnvironment.doc:
The activity record for CUPTI environmental data.

This activity record provides CUPTI environmental data, include power, clocks, and thermals. This information is sampled at various rates and returned in this activity record. The consumer of the record needs to check the environmentKind field to figure out what kind of environmental record this is.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_ENVIRONMENT`].

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device.

timestamp.doc:
The timestamp when this sample was retrieved, in ns.

A value of 0 indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the marker.

environmentKind.doc: The kind of data reported in this record.

power.doc:
Data returned for [`CUpti_ActivityEnvironmentKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_ENVIRONMENT_POWER`] environment kind.

The power in milliwatts consumed by GPU and associated circuitry. The power in milliwatts that will trigger power management algorithm.

CUpti_ActivityComputeEngineCtxSwitch.doc:
The activity record for trace of CUDA context switch events.

The corresponding activity kind is [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH`].

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH`].

contextId.doc: The ID of the CUDA context.

timestamp.doc: The timestamp at which the CUpti_ComputeEngineCtxSwitchOperationType occurs.

operationType.doc:
The type of the Compute Engine Context switch operation.

[`CUpti_ComputeEngineCtxSwitchOperationType::CUPTI_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_OPERATION_START`] indicates the start of the context switch operation. [`CUpti_ComputeEngineCtxSwitchOperationType::CUPTI_COMPUTE_ENGINE_CTX_SWITCH_OPERATION_END`] indicates the end of the context switch operation.

CUpti_ActivityNvLink.doc:
NVLink information.

(deprecated in CUDA 9.0)

This structure gives capabilities of each logical NVLink connection between two devices, gpu<->gpu or gpu<->CPU which can be used to understand the topology. NVLink information are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityNvLink5](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityNvLink5.html#structcupti__activitynvlink5) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NVLINK`].

index.doc:
Index of the NPU.

First index will always be zero.

domainId.doc:
Domain ID of NPU.

On Linux, this can be queried using lspci.

idDev0.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 0.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

idDev1.doc:
If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 1.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

flag.doc:
Flag gives capabilities of the link.

See also

[CUpti_LinkFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga819d686d23d2a3dfed9cc1d3c4ecb162).

physicalNvLinkCount.doc: Number of physical NVLinks present between two devices.

portDev0.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 4 NVLinks connected to device 0.

If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

portDev1.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 4 NVLinks connected to device 1.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpy.doc:
The activity record for memory copies.

(deprecated)

This activity record represents a memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the memory copy.

runtimeCorrelationId.doc:
The runtime correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique runtime correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the runtime API activity record that launched the memory copy.

CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousMetricInstanc.doc:
The instantaneous activity record for a CUPTI metric with instance information.

This activity record represents a CUPTI metric value for a specific metric domain instance ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC_INSTANCE`]) sampled at a particular time. This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profiler frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect metric data may choose to use this type to store the collected metric data. This activity record should be used when metric domain instance information needs to be associated with the metric.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_METRIC_INSTANCE`].

timestamp.doc: The timestamp at which metric is sampled.

deviceId.doc: The device id.

flags.doc:
The properties of this metric.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

structSize.doc:
Size of the data structure.

CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

fieldSelection.doc: Selection of the fields to collect for the activity kind.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

pHostObject.doc: [in] reference to the profiler host object allocated by CUPTI in cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

pMetricName.doc: [in] metric name for which its properties will be listed. Metric name can be with or without extension (rollup or submetric).

pDescription.doc: [out] a short description about the metric.

pHwUnit.doc: [out] associated hw unit for the metric.

pDimUnit.doc: [out] the dimension of the metric values.

metricType.doc: [out] the metric type (counter, ratio or throughput).

numOfRangeDropped.doc: [out] Number of ranges dropped in the processed passes.

CUpti_ActivityMemset2.doc:
The activity record for memset.

(deprecated in CUDA 11.1)

This activity record represents a memory set operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMSET`].

value.doc: The value being assigned to memory by the memory set.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes being set by the memory set.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory set, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory set.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory set, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory set.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory set is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory set is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory set is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory set.

Each memory set is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the memory set.

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memset.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

memoryKind.doc:
The memory kind of the memory set.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that executed this memset through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memset is not executed through graph launch.

cuDevice.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

isSupported.doc: [out] overall SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED flag representing whether Profiling and PC Sampling APIs work on the given device and configuration. SUPPORTED if all following flags are SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

architecture.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if the device architecture level supports the Profiling API (Compute Capability >= 7.0), UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

sli.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if SLI is not enabled, UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

vGpu.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if vGPU is supported and profiling is enabled, DISABLED if profiling is supported but not enabled, UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

confidentialCompute.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if confidential compute is not enabled, UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

cmp.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if not NVIDIA Crypto Mining Processors (CMP), UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

wsl.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if WSL supported, UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

api.doc: [in] the CUPTI API type for which device support will be checked.

sku.doc: [out] SUPPORTED if SKU supported, UNSUPPORTED otherwise.

CUpti_ActivityMemoryPool3.doc:
The activity record for memory pool.

This activity record represents a memory pool creation, destruction and trimming ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY_POOL`]). This activity record provides separate records for memory pool creation, destruction and trimming operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory pool operation.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY_POOL`].

memoryPoolOperationType.doc: The memory operation requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga878fb2c94e0051169fdf0ca7982612a2).

memoryPoolType.doc: The type of the memory pool, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory pool operation.

Each memory pool operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory operation.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory pool is created.

minBytesToKeep.doc:
The minimum bytes to keep of the memory pool.

`minBytesToKeep` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_OPERATION_TYPE_TRIMMED`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga878fb2c94e0051169fdf0ca7982612a2).

address.doc: The virtual address of the allocation.

size.doc:
The size of the memory pool operation in bytes.

`size` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

releaseThreshold.doc:
The release threshold of the memory pool.

`releaseThreshold` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

timestamp.doc: The start timestamp for the memory operation, in ns.

utilizedSize.doc:
The utilized size of the memory pool.

`utilizedSize` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

isManagedPool.doc:
Whether the pool is of managed memory allocation or pinned memory allocation.

If it is 0, it is pinned and if it is 1, the memory pool allocation is of managed memory type.

CUpti_ActivityPCSampling3.doc:
The activity record for PC sampling.

This activity records information obtained by sampling PC ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_PC_SAMPLING`].

flags.doc: The properties of this instruction.

correlationId.doc: The correlation ID of the kernel to which this result is associated.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

latencySamples.doc:
Number of times the PC was sampled with the stallReason in the record.

These samples indicate that no instruction was issued in that cycle from the warp scheduler from where the warp was sampled. Field is valid for devices with compute capability 6.0 and higher.

samples.doc:
Number of times the PC was sampled with the stallReason in the record.

The same PC can be sampled with different stall reasons. The count includes latencySamples.

stallReason.doc:
Current stall reason.

Includes one of the reasons from [CUpti_ActivityPCSamplingStallReason](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga57bafb9baafeae0880dae6eaa1a8e12d).

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the instruction.

pOptions.doc: [in] Pointer to Counter Data Image Options.

CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousMetric.doc:
The activity record for an instantaneous CUPTI metric.

This activity record represents the collection of a CUPTI metric value ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_METRIC`]) at a particular instance. This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profiler frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect metric data may choose to use this type to store the collected metric data.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_METRIC`].

timestamp.doc: The timestamp at which metric is sampled.

deviceId.doc: The device id.

flags.doc:
The properties of this metric.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

metricId.doc: [in] unique id for the SASS metric, can be queried using [cuptiSassMetricsGetProperties()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__SASS__METRICS__API.html#group__cupti__sass__metrics__api_1ga391895709314386ece556a4e69f727ef).

pCounterDataImage.doc: [in] the counter data image where profiling data has been decoded.

rangeIndex.doc: [in] range index for which the range name will be queried.

delimiter.doc: [in] used in case of nested ranges, default=”/”. Range1<delimiter>Range2.

pRangeName.doc: [out] the range name. Note: that the CUPTI allocate the memory internal and its user responsibility to free up the allocated memory.

ctx.doc: [in] CUDA context on which SASS metric data collection was enabled. If set NULL, default context will be consider for SASS metric data collection.

numOfPatchedInstructionRecords.doc: [out] total number of SASS records has been collected.

numOfInstances.doc: [out] number of instances for each metric value per instruction. This will depend on CUpti_SassPatching_OutputGranularity level set for the metric config.

CUpti_ActivityNvLink4.doc:
NVLink information.

(deprecated in CUDA 13.2)

This structure gives capabilities of each logical NVLink connection between two devices, gpu<->gpu or gpu<->CPU which can be used to understand the topology. NvLink information is now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityNvLink5](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityNvLink5.html#structcupti__activitynvlink5) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NVLINK`].

index.doc:
Index of the NPU.

First index will always be zero.

domainId.doc:
Domain ID of NPU.

On Linux, this can be queried using lspci.

idDev0.doc:
If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 0.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

idDev1.doc:
If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_GPU`], UUID for device 1.

[CUpti_ActivityDevice6](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityDevice6.html#structcupti__activitydevice6). If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], struct npu for NPU.

flag.doc:
Flag gives capabilities of the link.

See also

[CUpti_LinkFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga819d686d23d2a3dfed9cc1d3c4ecb162).

physicalNvLinkCount.doc: Number of physical NVLinks present between two devices.

portDev0.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 32 NVLinks connected to device 0.

If typeDev0 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

portDev1.doc:
Port numbers for maximum 32 NVLinks connected to device 1.

If typeDev1 is [`CUpti_DevType::CUPTI_DEV_TYPE_NPU`], ignore this field. In case of invalid/unknown port number, this field will be set to value CUPTI_NVLINK_INVALID_PORT. This will be used to correlate the metric values to individual physical link and attribute traffic to the logical NVLink in the topology.

nvswitchConnected.doc: NVSwitch is connected as an intermediate node.

structSize.doc: Size of the struct in bytes.

attributes.doc:
The attributes of the payload.

Depending on the type, typecast the pointer: [`CUpti_NvtxExtPayloadType::CUPTI_NVTX_EXT_PAYLOAD_TYPE_SCHEMA`]: nvtxPayloadSchemaAttr_t [`CUpti_NvtxExtPayloadType::CUPTI_NVTX_EXT_PAYLOAD_TYPE_ENUM`]: nvtxPayloadEnumAttr_t.

size.doc:
Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingDisableParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

PcSampDataBuffer.doc: Pointer to array of buffers to merge.

MergedPcSampDataBuffers.doc: Pointer to array of merged buffers as per the range id.

CUpti_ActivityContext.doc:
The activity record for a context.

This activity record represents information about a context ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`]). Context activity is now reported using [CUpti_ActivityContext3](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityContext3.html#structcupti__activitycontext3) record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONTEXT`].

contextId.doc: The context ID.

deviceId.doc: The device ID.

computeApiKind.doc:
The compute API kind.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityComputeApiKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaf46dcec421da358ab4e9edad76774179).

nullStreamId.doc: The ID for the NULL stream in this context.

CUpti_ActivityOpenAccOther.doc:
The activity record for OpenACC other.

([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_OTHER`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_OPENACC_OTHER`].

eventKind.doc:
CUPTI OpenACC event kind (.

See also

[CUpti_OpenAccEventKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga0e638b0b6a210164345ab159bcba6717)).

parentConstruct.doc:
CUPTI OpenACC parent construct kind (.

Note that for applications using PGI OpenACC runtime < 16.1, this will always be [`CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind::CUPTI_OPENACC_CONSTRUCT_KIND_UNKNOWN`].

See also

[CUpti_OpenAccConstructKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaad1f871f3bfe3f626520561cc767881e)).

implicit.doc: 1 for any implicit event, such as an implicit wait at a synchronous data construct 0 otherwise.

async.doc: Value of [async()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityOpenAccOther.html#structcupti__activityopenaccother_1a703828877b868e7068d7b902b4b5a5a7) clause of the corresponding directive.

lineNo.doc:
The line number of the directive or program construct or the starting line number of the OpenACC construct corresponding to the event.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

endLineNo.doc:
For an OpenACC construct, this contains the line number of the end of the construct.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

funcLineNo.doc:
The line number of the first line of the function named in func_name.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

funcEndLineNo.doc:
The last line number of the function named in func_name.

A negative or zero value means the line number is not known.

start.doc: CUPTI start timestamp.

end.doc: CUPTI end timestamp.

cuDeviceId.doc: CUDA device id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuContextId.doc: CUDA context id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuStreamId.doc: CUDA stream id Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia.

cuProcessId.doc: The ID of the process where the OpenACC activity is executing.

cuThreadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the OpenACC activity is executing.

externalId.doc:
The OpenACC correlation ID.

Valid only if deviceType is acc_device_nvidia. If not 0, it uniquely identifies this record. It is identical to the externalId in the preceding external correlation record of type [`CUpti_ExternalCorrelationKind::CUPTI_EXTERNAL_CORRELATION_KIND_OPENACC`].

srcFile.doc: A pointer to null-terminated string containing the name of or path to the source file, if known, or a null pointer if not.

funcName.doc: A pointer to a null-terminated string containing the name of the function in which the event occurred.

CUpti_ActivityInstructionCorrelation.doc:
The activity record for source-level sass/source line-by-line correlation.

This activity records source level sass/source correlation information. ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTRUCTION_CORRELATION`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTRUCTION_CORRELATION`].

flags.doc: The properties of this instruction.

functionId.doc: Correlation ID with global/device function name.

pcOffset.doc: The pc offset for the instruction.

CUpti_ActivityAPI.doc:
The activity record for a driver or runtime API invocation.

This activity record represents an invocation of a driver or runtime API ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DRIVER`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DRIVER`], [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME`], or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INTERNAL_LAUNCH_API`].

cbid.doc: The ID of the driver or runtime function.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the function, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the function.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the function, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the function.

processId.doc: The ID of the process where the driver or runtime CUDA function is executing.

threadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the driver or runtime CUDA function is executing.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the driver or runtime CUDA function.

Each function invocation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the memcpy, memset, or kernel activity record that is associated with this function.

returnValue.doc:
The return value for the function.

For a CUDA driver function with will be a CUresult value, and for a CUDA runtime function this will be a cudaError_t value.

structSize.doc:
Size of the data structure.

CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

subscriberName.doc:
Name given to the subscriber.

The subscriber name need not include the “CUPTI” prefix, as the CUPTI library automatically adds it as “CUPTI for <subscriberName>”. Can be NULL. An internal copy is created. Size must not exceed CUPTI_SUBSCRIBER_NAME_MAX_LEN to avoid truncation.

oldSubscriberName.doc:
In case of multiple subscribers not allowed, and a [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_MULTIPLE_SUBSCRIBERS_NOT_SUPPORTED`] return code, the name of the incompatible tool or the existing CUPTI subscriber will be written to this location.

Size should be greater than or equal to CUPTI_OLD_SUBSCRIBER_NAME_MIN_LEN to avoid truncation. Can be NULL. If multiple subscribers are allowed, this will be the name of the first subscriber, but [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_MULTIPLE_SUBSCRIBERS_NOT_SUPPORTED`] will not be returned.

oldSubscriberSize.doc:
Size of oldSubscriberName.

Minimum size should be CUPTI_OLD_SUBSCRIBER_NAME_MIN_LEN to avoid truncation.

allowMultipleSubscribers.doc:
Request to allow multiple subscribers.

If 0, requesting to disallow multiple subscribers. If 1, requesting to allow multiple subscribers. Note that cuptiSubscribe_v2 will return [`CUptiResult::CUPTI_ERROR_MULTIPLE_SUBSCRIBERS_NOT_SUPPORTED`] if the request cannot be fulfilled. Note that support is currently only for CUPTI shared library and not for CUPTI static library, but static library will be supported in future releases.

pOptions.doc: [in] Pointer to Counter Data Image Options.

CUpti_ActivityPcieGpuAttr.doc: Attributes for more information about GPU (gpuAttr).

peerDev.doc:
CUdevice with which this device has P2P capability.

This can also be obtained by querying cuDeviceCanAccessPeer or cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer APIs.

CUpti_ActivityKernel3.doc:
The activity record for a kernel (CUDA 6.5(with sm_52 support) onwards).

(deprecated in CUDA 9.0)

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]). Kernel activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityKernel9](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityKernel9.html#structcupti__activitykernel9) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

requested.doc:
The cache configuration requested by the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

executed.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:
The shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUsharedconfig enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

partitionedGlobalCacheRequested.doc:
The partitioned global caching requested for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2.

partitionedGlobalCacheExecuted.doc:
The partitioned global caching executed for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2. Partitioned global caching can be automatically disabled if the occupancy requirement of the launch cannot support caching.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

completed.doc:
The completed timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

It represents the completion of all it’s child kernels and the kernel itself. A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the completion time is unknown.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc: The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingGetDataParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

ctx.doc: [w] CUcontext.

CUpti_ActivityJit.doc:
The activity record for JIT operations.

This activity represents the JIT operations (compile, load, store) of a CUmodule from the Compute Cache. Gives the exact hashed path of where the cached module is loaded from, or where the module will be stored after Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation.

JIT activity is now reported using [CUpti_ActivityJit2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityJit2.html#structcupti__activityjit2) record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_JIT`].

deviceId.doc: The device ID.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the JIT operation, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the JIT operation.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the JIT operation, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the JIT operation.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the JIT operation to which records belong to.

Each JIT operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the JIT operation.

jitOperationCorrelationId.doc:
The correlation ID to correlate JIT compilation, load and store operations.

Each JIT compilation unit is assigned a unique correlation ID at the time of the JIT compilation. This correlation id can be used to find the matching JIT cache load/store records.

cachePath.doc: The path where the fat binary is cached.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpy4.doc:
The activity record for memory copies.

(deprecated in CUDA 11.6)

This activity record represents a memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the memory copy.

runtimeCorrelationId.doc:
The runtime correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique runtime correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the runtime API activity record that launched the memory copy.

graphNodeId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph node that executed this memcpy through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memcpy is not done through graph launch.

graphId.doc:
The unique ID of the graph that executed this memcpy through graph launch.

This field will be 0 if the memcpy is not done through graph launch.

counterDataSize.doc: [in] Size of the counter data image.

CUpti_ActivityDeviceAttribute.doc:
The activity record for a device attribute.

This activity record represents information about a GPU device: either a CUpti_DeviceAttribute or CUdevice_attribute value ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE`].

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the device.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device that this attribute applies to.

attribute.doc:
The attribute, either a CUpti_DeviceAttribute or CUdevice_attribute.

Flag [`CUpti_ActivityFlag::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_CUDEVICE`] is used to indicate what kind of attribute this is. If [`CUpti_ActivityFlag::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_FLAG_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_CUDEVICE`] is 1 then CUdevice_attribute field is value, otherwise CUpti_DeviceAttribute field is valid.

value.doc:
The value for the attribute.

See CUpti_DeviceAttribute and CUdevice_attribute for the type of the value for a given attribute.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

passIndex.doc:
[out] The targetNestingLevel that will be collected by the *next* BeginPass.

[out] The passIndex that will be collected by the *next* BeginPass.

allPassesSubmitted.doc: [out] becomes true when the last pass has been queued to the GPU.

counterDataImageSize.doc: [in] Size of the counter data image.

numTotalRanges.doc: [out] Number of ranges in the counter data image.

CUpti_ActivityMemcpyPtoP.doc:
The activity record for peer-to-peer memory copies.

This activity record represents a peer-to-peer memory copy ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`]) but is no longer generated by CUPTI. Peer-to-peer memory copy activities are now reported using the [CUpti_ActivityMemcpyPtoP2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemcpyPtoP2.html#structcupti__activitymemcpyptop2) activity record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY2`].

copyKind.doc:
The kind of the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemcpyKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga10056d66c2ee966fc5cde439eb0a3661).

srcKind.doc:
The source memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

dstKind.doc:
The destination memory kind read by the memory copy, stored as a byte to reduce record size.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

flags.doc:
The flags associated with the memory copy.

See also

[CUpti_ActivityFlag](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gaaef8ced52897c4377b0aee6196c37639).

bytes.doc: The number of bytes transferred by the memory copy.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory copy, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the memory copy.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory copy is occurring.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the memory copy is occurring.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the memory copy is occurring.

srcDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where memory is being copied from.

srcContextId.doc: The ID of the context owning the memory being copied from.

dstDeviceId.doc: The ID of the device where memory is being copied to.

dstContextId.doc: The ID of the context owning the memory being copied to.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory copy.

Each memory copy is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory copy.

CUpti_ActivityMemory.doc:
The activity record for memory.

This activity record represents a memory allocation and free operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY`]). This activity record provides a single record for the memory allocation and memory release operations.

Note: It is recommended to move to the new activity record [CUpti_ActivityMemory4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory4.html#structcupti__activitymemory4) enabled using the kind [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ggaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3afc702c2e896e657930de3685d4ea3233). [CUpti_ActivityMemory4](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory4.html#structcupti__activitymemory4) provides separate records for memory allocation and memory release operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory operation.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY`].

memoryKind.doc: The memory kind requested by the user.

address.doc: The virtual address of the allocation.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes of memory allocated.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the memory operation, i.e.

the time when memory was allocated, in ns.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the memory operation, i.e.

the time when memory was freed, in ns. This will be 0 if memory is not freed in the application.

allocPC.doc: The program counter of the allocation of memory.

freePC.doc:
The program counter of the freeing of memory.

This will be 0 if memory is not freed in the application.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory allocation is taking place.

contextId.doc:
The ID of the context.

If context is NULL, `contextId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_CONTEXT_ID.

name.doc:
Variable name.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same symbol, and so should not be modified.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

counterAvailabilityImageSize.doc: [in/out] If `pCounterAvailabilityImage` is NULL, then the required size is returned in `counterAvailabilityImageSize`, otherwise `counterAvailabilityImageSize` should be set to the size of `pCounterAvailabilityImage`, and on return it would be overwritten with number of actual bytes copied.

pCounterAvailabilityImage.doc: [in] buffer receiving counter availability image, may be NULL.

bAllowDeviceLevelCounters.doc: [in] if 1, device level counters are included in the counter availability image.

structSize.doc: [in] Size of the data structure. CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

pHostObject.doc: [in] reference to the profiler host object allocated by CUPTI in cuptiProfilerHostInitialize.

pChipName.doc: [in] chip name for which metrics will be queried.

numOfMetrics.doc: [in] number of metrics supported for the queried chip (can be queried using [cuptiSassMetricsGetNumOfMetrics()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__SASS__METRICS__API.html#group__cupti__sass__metrics__api_1ga3019950028060e943b12b7fc6f1b9188)).

pMetricsList.doc: [out] list of metrics supported for queried chip.

CUpti_ActivityMemory2.doc:
The activity record for memory.

This activity record represents a memory allocation and free operation ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2`]). This activity record provides separate records for memory allocation and memory release operations. This allows to correlate the corresponding driver and runtime API activity record with the memory operation.

Note: This activity record is an upgrade over [CUpti_ActivityMemory](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory.html#structcupti__activitymemory) enabled using the kind [CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ggaefed720d5a60c3e8b286cd386c4913e3afee93ef030088d7a992a1abd6d6e53b0). [CUpti_ActivityMemory](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityMemory.html#structcupti__activitymemory) provides a single record for the memory allocation and memory release operations.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMORY2`].

memoryOperationType.doc: The memory operation requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryOperationType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga6404b89cfbbd60e04204244d230b15c4).

memoryKind.doc: The memory kind requested by the user, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga9969b86f0e54989b27080dc6083263bc).

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the memory operation.

Each memory operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver and runtime API activity record that launched the memory operation.

address.doc:
The virtual address of the allocation.

The base address of the memory pool.

bytes.doc: The number of bytes of memory allocated.

timestamp.doc: The start timestamp for the memory operation, in ns.

PC.doc: The program counter of the memory operation.

processId.doc: The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the memory operation is taking place.

contextId.doc:
The ID of the context.

If context is NULL, `contextId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_CONTEXT_ID.

streamId.doc:
The ID of the stream.

If memory operation is not async, `streamId` is set to CUPTI_INVALID_STREAM_ID.

name.doc:
Variable name.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same symbol, and so should not be modified.

isAsync.doc: `isAsync` is set if memory operation happens through async memory APIs.

memoryPoolType.doc: The type of the memory pool, [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

releaseThreshold.doc:
The release threshold of the memory pool in bytes.

`releaseThreshold` is valid for [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

pool.doc:
The size of the memory pool in bytes and the processID of the memory pool.

`size` is valid if `memoryPoolType` is [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_LOCAL`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8). `processId` is valid if `memoryPoolType` is [`CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_MEMORY_POOL_TYPE_IMPORTED`], [CUpti_ActivityMemoryPoolType](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga8c40b23a5fe82862b18d60c5c42399a8).

memoryPoolConfig.doc: The memory pool configuration used for the memory operations.

CUpti_ActivityInstantaneousEventInstance.doc:
The activity record for an instantaneous CUPTI event with event domain instance information.

This activity record represents the a CUPTI event value for a specific event domain instance ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT_INSTANCE`]) sampled at a particular instant. This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profiler frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect event data may choose to use this type to store the collected event data. This activity record should be used when event domain instance information needs to be associated with the event.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_INSTANTANEOUS_EVENT_INSTANCE`].

timestamp.doc: The timestamp at which event is sampled.

deviceId.doc: The device id.

CUpti_ActivityEventInstance.doc:
The activity record for a CUPTI event with instance information.

This activity record represents the a CUPTI event value for a specific event domain instance ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT_INSTANCE`]). This activity record kind is not produced by the activity API but is included for completeness and ease-of-use. Profile frameworks built on top of CUPTI that collect event data may choose to use this type to store the collected event data. This activity record should be used when event domain instance information needs to be associated with the event.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_EVENT_INSTANCE`].

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the event.

Use of this ID is user-defined, but typically this ID value will equal the correlation ID of the kernel for which the event was gathered.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GRAPH_HOST_NODE`].

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream that waits for the graph host node to finish.

contextId.doc: The ID of the CUDA context to which the waiting CUDA stream belongs.

deviceId.doc:
The ID of the CUDA device to which the CUDA context and stream belong.

The graph host node is executing on the CPU, but it is associated with the CUDA device through the CUDA context and stream.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the graph host node operation.

Each operation is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver API activity record that launched the operation.

graphId.doc: The unique ID of the graph that executed this host node through graph launch.

graphNodeId.doc: The unique ID of the graph node that executed this host node through graph launch.

processId.doc: The ID of the process where the host node is executing.

threadId.doc: The ID of the thread where the host node is executing.

start.doc:
The start timestamp.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the start time is unknown.

end.doc:
The end timestamp.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the start time is unknown.

ctx.doc: [in] if NULL, the current CUcontext is used.

pConfig.doc: [in] Config created by NVPW_RawMetricsConfig_GetConfigImage(). Must be align(8).

minNestingLevel.doc: [in] the lowest nesting level to be profiled; must be >= 1.

numNestingLevels.doc: [in] the number of nesting levels to profile; must be >= 1.

passIndex.doc: [in] Set this to zero for in-app replay; set this to the output of EndPass() for application replay.

targetNestingLevel.doc: [in] Set this to minNestingLevel for in-app replay; set this to the output of EndPass() for application.

functionIndex.doc: [out] function’s unique symbol index in the module.

pcOffset.doc: [out] pc offset for the function in a module.

pInstanceValues.doc: [out] array of size equal to number of instances per metric, which contains the metric ID and metric value.

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingEnableParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

ctx.doc: [w] CUcontext.

gpuTemperature.doc: The GPU temperature in degrees C.

CUpti_ActivityName.doc:
The activity record providing a name.

This activity record provides a name for a device, context, thread, etc. and other resource naming done via NVTX APIs ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NAME`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_NAME`].

objectKind.doc: The kind of activity object being named.

objectId.doc:
The identifier for the activity object.

‘objectKind’ indicates which ID is valid for this record.

name.doc: The name.

ctx.doc: [in] CUDA context on which SASS metric data collection will be enabled. If set NULL, default context will be consider for SASS metric data collection.

enableLazyPatching.doc: [in] if false, all the functions will patched regardless of their execution with [cuptiSassMetricsEnable()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__SASS__METRICS__API.html#group__cupti__sass__metrics__api_1ga62ea0db81c966ddf066c28644f8b240f) API call. when this parameter is set to true, metric data collection for the function will be done at the very first execution in the enable/disble range.

CUpti_ActivityGreenContext.doc:
The activity record for a green context.

This activity record represents information about a green context ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`]). Green context activity is now reported using [CUpti_ActivityGreenContext2](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/structCUpti__ActivityGreenContext2.html#structcupti__activitygreencontext2) record.

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_GREEN_CONTEXT`].

contextId.doc: The context ID of the green context.

parentContextId.doc: The ID of the parent context.

deviceId.doc: The device ID associated with the green context.

numTpcs.doc: The number of TPCs allocated to the green context.

numMultiprocessors.doc: The number of multiprocessors (SMs) allocated to the green context.

logicalTpcMaskSize.doc: The size (in 32-bit words) of the logical TPC mask stored in logicalTpcMask[].

logicalTpcMask.doc:
Bitset of allocated TPC IDs represented as 32-bit words.

Valid words are specified by logicalTpcMaskSize; unused entries are zeroed. The array supports up to 1024 TPCs (32 words × 32 bits). Each bit represents a logical TPC ID assigned to the green context. For example, if bit k is set, logical TPC ID k is assigned to the context.

**Example: Interpreting the TPC Mask**
:   For a green context with numTpcs=3, logicalTpcMaskSize=8, and logicalTpcMask={66,8,0,0,0,0,0,0}:

* Word 0: Value 66 (binary: …01000010, showing lowest 8 bits of 32-bit word) indicates TPCs 1 and 6
* Word 1: Value 8 (binary: …00001000) indicates TPC 35 (bit 3 of word 1, i.e., global TPC ID 32+3)
* Each word is 32 bits covering TPCs 0-31 (word 0), 32-63 (word 1), etc.
* To check if TPC N is allocated: (logicalTpcMask[N/32] & (1U << (N%32)))
* logicalTpcMaskSize indicates how many words in the array contain valid data.

CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounter.doc:
The activity record for Unified Memory counters (deprecated in CUDA 7.0)

This activity record represents a Unified Memory counter ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_UNIFIED_MEMORY_COUNTER`].

counterKind.doc:
The Unified Memory counter kind.

See [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterKind](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga601877eb6f7d248a5f538fd74b8fa782).

scope.doc:
Scope of the Unified Memory counter.

See [CUpti_ActivityUnifiedMemoryCounterScope](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1gacf829db187f1553461cea1a6c9e6748b).

deviceId.doc:
The ID of the device involved in the memory transfer operation.

It is not relevant if the scope of the counter is global (all devices).

timestamp.doc:
The timestamp when this sample was retrieved, in ns.

A value of 0 indicates that timestamp information could not be collected.

processId.doc:
The ID of the process to which this record belongs to.

In case of global scope, processId is undefined.

size.doc:
[w] Size of the data structure i.e.

CUpti_PCSamplingDisableParamsSize CUPTI client should set the size of the structure. It will be used in CUPTI to check what fields are available in the structure. Used to preserve backward compatibility.

ctx.doc: [w] CUcontext.

CUpti_ActivityKernel8.doc:
The activity record for kernel.

This activity record represents a kernel execution ([`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] and [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`]).

kind.doc: The activity record kind, must be [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL`] or [`CUpti_ActivityKind::CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`].

requested.doc:
The cache configuration requested by the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

executed.doc:
The cache configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUfunc_cache enumeration values from cuda.h.

cacheConfig.doc: For devices with compute capability 7.5+ cacheConfig values are not updated in case field isSharedMemoryCarveoutRequested is set.

sharedMemoryConfig.doc:
The shared memory configuration used for the kernel.

The value is one of the CUsharedconfig enumeration values from cuda.h.

registersPerThread.doc: The number of registers required for each thread executing the kernel.

partitionedGlobalCacheRequested.doc:
The partitioned global caching requested for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2.

partitionedGlobalCacheExecuted.doc:
The partitioned global caching executed for the kernel.

Partitioned global caching is required to enable caching on certain chips, such as devices with compute capability 5.2. Partitioned global caching can be automatically disabled if the occupancy requirement of the launch cannot support caching.

start.doc:
The start timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

end.doc:
The end timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

A value of 0 for both the start and end timestamps indicates that timestamp information could not be collected for the kernel.

completed.doc:
The completed timestamp for the kernel execution, in ns.

It represents the completion of all it’s child kernels and the kernel itself. A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the completion time is unknown.

deviceId.doc: The ID of the device where the kernel is executing.

contextId.doc: The ID of the context where the kernel is executing.

streamId.doc: The ID of the stream where the kernel is executing.

gridX.doc: The X-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridY.doc: The Y-dimension grid size for the kernel.

gridZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

blockX.doc: The X-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockY.doc: The Y-dimension block size for the kernel.

blockZ.doc: The Z-dimension grid size for the kernel.

staticSharedMemory.doc: The static shared memory allocated for the kernel, in bytes.

dynamicSharedMemory.doc: The dynamic shared memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes.

localMemoryPerThread.doc: The amount of local memory reserved for each thread, in bytes.

localMemoryTotal.doc:
The total amount of local memory reserved for the kernel, in bytes (deprecated in CUDA 11.8).

Refer field localMemoryTotal_v2.

correlationId.doc:
The correlation ID of the kernel.

Each kernel execution is assigned a unique correlation ID that is identical to the correlation ID in the driver or runtime API activity record that launched the kernel.

gridId.doc:
The grid ID of the kernel.

Each kernel is assigned a unique grid ID at runtime.

name.doc:
The name of the kernel.

This name is shared across all activity records representing the same kernel, and so should not be modified.

queued.doc:
The timestamp when the kernel is queued up in the command buffer, in ns.

A value of CUPTI_TIMESTAMP_UNKNOWN indicates that the queued time could not be collected for the kernel. This timestamp is not collected by default. Use API [cuptiActivityEnableLatencyTimestamps()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cupti/api/group__CUPTI__ACTIVITY__API.html#group__cupti__activity__api_1ga4b50c0c1634913f8157cfcfe84f19fa9) to enable collection.
